assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Two consequences drive this whole record: (1) resale — low-mileage cars sell above the mileage-blind 行情, so every used-price anchor below was taken from a real listing verified live on 2026-08-11 and then adjusted toward the low-mileage end of the observed spread, with the adjustment stated in each source string; (2) maintenance — Lexus Taiwan's service interval is 6 months OR 10,000 km, whichever comes first, so at 7,000 km/yr servicing is entirely TIME-driven (2 visits every year, ~3,500 km apart). Mileage-triggered items land very late or never: total lifetime mileage at year 10 is only 70,000 km, so spark plugs (~100,000 km on the A25A-FXS) never come due, and e-CVT/hybrid transaxle fluid (~60,000 km) arrives only around year 8-9. Conversely, age-driven consumables dominate: tires time out on rubber age (~5-6 years) long before tread depth, so the first set falls in the 5-7 year window rather than at exactly year 5, and the 12V AGM auxiliary battery ages out on calendar time. Purchase excludes tax and insurance by design (no 牌照稅/燃料稅, no 強制險/任意險). Method note: predecessor retention ratios are expressed against the predecessor's LIST price and therefore applied to this car's LIST price (2,560,000), not to real_cost, so that ratio numerator and denominator stay on the same basis.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-11 against three sources: 8891新車 MY2026 RX price table (RX 350h 豪華版 = NT$2,560,000), TVBS 地球黃金線 2026 RX spec table (350h豪華版 256萬), and Lexus Taiwan's official RX page (family range NT$246~361萬, consistent). Discount: derived from two REAL PTT 菜單 (dealer quotation sheets), both fetched and confirmed genuine — RX350H 豪華版 on 2025-11-02 got NT$300,000 off 256萬 (final 229.6萬 including 3.6萬 self-paid accessories), and RX350H 頂級版 on 2025-10-16 got NT$280,000 off 278萬 (final 253.8萬). Onroad_fees: taken line-by-line from the same RX350H 豪華版 菜單 (自費配件 NT$36,000 = 極黑前擋隔熱紙升級 8,000 + 行車記錄器 13,000 + 原廠鍍膜 15,000) plus ~NT$8,000 領牌規費與代辦, rounded to 45,000.
purchase.notes: DELIBERATE DEVIATION from the 'Lexus barely discounts, use 0' heuristic, and the adversarial re-check CONFIRMS the deviation is correct. Both PTT 菜單 were fetched and are genuine: the 2025-11-02 RX350H 豪華版 sheet shows exactly 256萬 list, 30萬 off, 3.6萬 accessories, 229.6萬 final, with the accessory breakdown matching item for item. The 5th-gen RX (AL30) launched in Taiwan in Jan 2023 and is well into its cycle with only cosmetic MY2026 updates (2.5D wheel-cap logo, 3x brighter ambient LED, no price change), which is exactly when Hotai/Lexus dealers move to volume pricing. 260,000 is set rather than the observed 300,000 because those menus were year-end / pre-new-model-year clearance deals on 2025-built stock, the seasonal peak; a mid-2026 buyer negotiating normally should land in the 240,000-280,000 band. This is mildly conservative — both verified data points are ABOVE 260,000 — so real_cost carries a small upward bias of at most ~40,000. Onroad_fees deliberately contains only 領牌 + 代辦 + 配件; the source 菜單 explicitly lists 保險 and 稅金 as 實報實銷/另計, so excluding them matches how the quote is actually structured. Source conflict, re-confirmed: kingautos.net prices this trim at NT$2,550,000 rather than 2,560,000; 2,560,000 wins on a two-to-one source count and consistency with the published 246-361萬 family range, and the 10,000 gap is 0.4% either way. Trim note VERIFIED on kingautos: 豪華版 is the entry 350h trim and is 前輪驅動 (FWD); the 350h 旗艦版 is AWD. Powertrain VERIFIED: 2,487cc naturally aspirated inline-4 (190 hp) with electric motor for 250 hp system output and e-CVT — distinct from the RX350's 2.4L turbo. Battery chemistry is described as NiMH in secondary sources but was NOT confirmed by any source fetched here; treat that detail as unverified. It has no effect on any number in this record.

Detailing is set at the upper end of the normal 4,000-8,000 band because a premium large SUV needs more panel area polished and a 19-inch wheel/tire clean-up to photograph competitively against dealer stock — a scruffy premium car loses far more than 7,000 in negotiation. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer at dealer_tradein_price, selling costs are effectively zero (the dealer handles 過戶 and there is nothing to list or prep), so this figure applies to the private-sale path only. Total is within the 4,000-15,000 band for this class and the three line items sum exactly to 11,500.

value_checkpoints.source: Dealer-retail anchored on live 8891 中古車 listings for the 2-year-old (2024) 5th-gen RX, then stepped back one year. VERIFIED on 8891 2026-08-11: 2024 RX350 頂級版 with only 14,000 km asking NT$2,088,000 (77.9% of its 2,680,000 list) — the closest LOW-MILEAGE analogue to this buyer; 2024 RX350 豪華版 27,600 km NT$1,828,000 (74.3% of 2,460,000); 2024 RX350 旗艦版 31,200 km NT$2,198,000; 2024 RX350 F Sport AWD 35,000 km NT$2,388,000. CORRECTION vs prior draft: the prior draft quoted the 2024 band as 1,828,000-2,198,000 at 27,600-39,900 km, which both understated the top of the band and omitted the 14,000 km car entirely — the single most relevant low-mileage anchor. That car sitting at 77.9% of list at TWO years made the prior 1-year dealer-retail estimate of 79.3% imply only ~1.4 points of depreciation across a full year, which is not credible. Dealer retail raised to ~NT$2,080,000 (81.3% of list). The ceiling is still genuinely capped by new-car discounting: the verified PTT 菜單 shows 300,000 off list, i.e. ~2,300,000 transaction, so a used 1-year car cannot approach list. ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED: dealer retail 2,080,000 -> private sale 1,870,000 (-10.1%, the 車商售價 to 自售價 step) -> dealer trade-in 1,655,000 (-11.5%, the 車商收購價 step). Low-mileage premium is small at 1 year because nearly every 1-year car is low-mileage.

Strongest data point in this record and INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED on 8891 中古車 2026-08-11: a 2023 RX350h 豪華版 — this exact trim at this exact age — with 40,200 km asking NT$1,758,000 (68.7% of its 2,560,000 list), alongside 2023 RX350h 旗艦版 39,000 km NT$2,258,000 and 2023 RX350 豪華版 30,000 km NT$1,680,000. Those cars have run ~11,500-13,000 km/yr, i.e. Taiwan-average. Our car at 21,000 km has done ~48% less, so the retail ratio is lifted from 68.7% to ~72.5% of list -> dealer retail ~NT$1,860,000. ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED: 1,860,000 dealer retail -> 1,670,000 private sale (-10.2%) -> 1,460,000 dealer trade-in (-12.6%). Independent cross-check of the private figure: the observed 1,758,000 dealer ask on the higher-mileage same-trim car implies a private sale near 1,580,000 for THAT car; adding the low-mileage premium for 19,200 fewer km lands at ~1,670,000, which is exactly where this sits — so this is a true 自售價, not a copied dealer ask. UNCHANGED from the prior draft; it survived the adversarial check. Note the year1->3 curve stays flat (-10.7% over two years) because heavy new-car discounting compresses the 1-year ceiling while the 3-year price is set independently by used-market demand.

EXTRAPOLATED — the 5th-gen RX only launched in Taiwan in Jan 2023, so no genuine 5-year data for this generation exists and none was invented. Method: take the PREDECESSOR 4th-gen RX (AL20, 2019 facelift; TW list RX300 豪華版 NT$2,270,000 / 頂級版 2,440,000 / 旗艦版 2,640,000, VERIFIED on CarStuff 2026-08-11), read its real used prices at that age off 8891, express as a retention ratio of its own list, then apply to this car. VERIFIED 8891 anchors 2026-08-11: a 2020 RX300 豪華版 with only 22,000 km asking NT$1,238,000 = 54.5% of 2,270,000 at SIX years and genuinely low mileage; a 2020 RX300 頂級版 at 70,000 km asking NT$1,148,000 = 47.0%, showing a ~7.5-point mileage spread at the same age. Interpolating our verified year-3 hybrid ratio (72.5%) toward the 6-year low-mileage 54.5% gives ~60.5% for a gasoline-equivalent at 5 years. CORRECTION vs prior draft: the prior draft applied the RX300 (2.0 turbo GASOLINE) ratio with no hybrid uplift. Toyota/Lexus hybrids retain above the gasoline market in Taiwan, so ~62% is used -> 2,560,000 x 0.62 = ~NT$1,585,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED: 1,585,000 dealer retail -> 1,420,000 private sale (-10.4%) -> 1,235,000 dealer trade-in (-13.0%). Still inside the 5yr/140,000 km cover (4yr base + the earned 1yr/20,000 km extension), which supports the price.

EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor 4th-gen RX, same method as the 5-year point — no genuine 7-year data exists for the 5th-gen RX. VERIFIED 8891 anchors 2026-08-11: 2018 RX300 頂級版 62,600 km asking NT$1,138,000 = 46.6% of its 2,440,000 list at EIGHT years; 2020 RX300 豪華版 22,000 km NT$1,238,000 = 54.5% at SIX years; 2020 RX300 F Sport 101,000 km NT$1,328,000 = 50.3% at six; 2019 RX300 F Sport 119,000 km NT$1,088,000 = 41.2% at seven but at very high mileage. CORRECTION vs prior draft, which contained two compounding pessimisms: (a) it used ~46% retention at SEVEN years, but 46.6% is the EIGHT-year ratio — an off-by-one-year error that charged this car an extra year of depreciation; (b) it applied a gasoline RX300 ratio to a Lexus hybrid with no uplift. Interpolating 6yr/54.5% and 8yr/46.6%, then mileage-correcting for 49,000 km (7,000 km/yr, well below the ~11,000 km/yr of the comparables), then adding a modest hybrid-retention uplift, gives ~50.5% -> 2,560,000 x 0.505 = ~NT$1,290,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED: 1,290,000 dealer retail -> 1,150,000 private sale (-10.9%) -> 990,000 dealer trade-in (-13.9%); the private-to-trade-in gap widens with age because dealers price in longer lot time. Confidence stays low: the ratio still comes from a different generation with a different powertrain (RX300 2.0 turbo vs this 2.5 HEV), and the 5th-gen's discount-compressed early curve may not converge on the 4th-gen's late curve.

EXTRAPOLATED from predecessor generations — no 10-year data for the 5th-gen RX can exist (it is 3 years old). Closest real hybrid comparables, both listings FETCHED AND CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-08-11: abc好車網 2016 RX450h 旗艦版 at NT$1,188,000 = 35.1% of its ~3,380,000 list, and abc好車網 2016 RX450h 頂級版 at NT$1,288,000 = 41.8% of its ~3,080,000 list; FindCar shows a 2016 RX450h at NT$798,000 for the worn end of the spread. NEITHER abc好車網 listing publishes mileage, which is the main limit on this point. Note the systematic pattern in those two: the CHEAPER trim retains the HIGHER percentage (41.8% vs 35.1%), which is the normal premium-flagship effect. CORRECTION vs prior draft: the prior draft used 34% retention — BELOW both verified 10-year hybrid anchors — for a car that is (i) the entry trim and cheaper than both comparables, so structurally higher-retaining, (ii) one-owner at 70,000 km, i.e. near the top of the condition spread, and (iii) a Lexus hybrid, which the Taiwan market holds above the gasoline market. ~37.5% is used -> 2,560,000 x 0.375 = ~NT$960,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENTS APPLIED: 960,000 dealer retail -> 845,000 private sale (-12.0%) -> 710,000 dealer trade-in (-16.0%); the gap is widest here because a 10-year-old car ties up a dealer's floor for months. Downside already priced in: the hybrid pack is outside its 8yr/160,000 km warranty by then and Taiwan buyers discount for that even when the pack is healthy.

maintenance.plan_notes: NO free scheduled maintenance in Taiwan — do not model this like the Lexus programs in some other markets. VERIFIED 2026-08-11 on Lexus Taiwan's own 保養計劃 page: only the 1-month new-car inspection is free, every scheduled service after it is paid. Hotai additionally gives a free annual safety check, a 1.5% Hotai Points rebate on service spending, a free loaner if a repair exceeds 72 hours, and free pickup/delivery within 10 km. WARRANTY, verified on the official 車主權益 page: 4 years / 120,000 km on the car, replacement parts 2 years / 50,000 km. There is a genuine free extension worth modelling, verified on the official announcement page: complete 8 CONSECUTIVE on-time 定保 (every 6 months for 4 years) using the official 定保套餐 and you get a free +1 year / 20,000 km, for vehicles delivered from 2024-01-01 — so this owner effectively runs 5 years / 140,000 km of cover. That is why the year-7 and year-10 windows carry an out-of-warranty repair reserve and years 1-5 do not. HYBRID BATTERY, verified: 8 years / 160,000 km total (5yr/100,000 km from Lexus plus 3yr/60,000 km added by Hotai) — at 7,000 km/yr the km cap is irrelevant, the 8-year clock is what expires. INTERVAL, verified: 1 month, then 6 months / 10,000 km whichever comes first, with 12-month, 24-month and 48-month majors. At 7,000 km/yr this is 100% TIME-DRIVEN: 2 visits every year, ~3,500 km apart, and the odometer never triggers a service. That is the single biggest cost fact here — the owner pays for 20 services over 10 years while covering only 70,000 km. Mileage-triggered items mostly never arrive: spark plugs (A25A-FXS, ~100,000 km) are never due inside 10 years, and hybrid transaxle fluid (~60,000 km) lands only around year 8-9. What DOES drive cost is calendar-aged consumables: two full sets of 235/60R19 tires (rubber ages out at 5-6 years regardless of tread), two 12V AGM auxiliary batteries, and brake fluid every 2 years. Brake friction material lasts unusually long because regenerative braking does most of the work, so front pads and discs sit in the 7-10 year window and are as likely to be replaced for disc corrosion as for wear. TIRE PHASING CORRECTED vs prior draft: the first tire set now sits in the 5-7 year window rather than at exactly year 5.0, because the stated ageing window is 5-6 years and a set fitted at delivery therefore times out inside the 5-7 period, not on the 5-year boundary. This also removes a non-monotonic dip the prior draft had at year 7. COST BASIS CAVEAT: Lexus Taiwan publishes no price list, so the ~NT$4,500 minor / ~NT$7,500 annual per-visit figures are a build-up from published per-item ranges, and the main secondary source for those ranges was verified to be an AI-authored blog post rather than a receipt or dealer quote. Every maintenance checkpoint is therefore confidence low.

12-month 定保: oil + filter + cabin filter check + brake/suspension inspection (~7,500)

All repairs covered by the 4yr/120,000 km warranty — zero repair spend

checkpoints.source: Visits and service items from the officially-verified Lexus Taiwan 保養計劃 interval table (48-month major confirmed on that page); the free +1yr/20,000 km extension from the official 準時定保 announcement, verified 2026-08-11. TIRES — first full set of 4 x 235/60R19 replaced on AGE not tread (~32,000), timing out at ~5.5 years. At 7,000 km/yr the original tires have only ~38,000 km and plenty of depth; this is the classic low-mileage cost that mileage-based models miss entirely

checkpoints.source: Interval basis from the officially-verified Lexus Taiwan 保養計劃; warranty expiry from the official 車主權益 page (4yr/120,000 km, verified) plus the earned 1yr/20,000 km extension (official announcement, verified). Tire cost estimated from Taiwan retail for premium 235/60R19 SUV tires (Michelin Primacy SUV+ / Bridgestone Alenza class, ~NT$7,000-8,000 each fitted and balanced). CORRECTION vs prior draft: the first tire set is phased into this window rather than year 5, which is both the correct reading of the 5-6 year rubber-ageing rule for a set fitted at delivery and the fix for the prior draft's non-monotonic maintenance profile. major_items: 6 scheduled visits over 3 years (~36,000)
TIRES — second full set of 4 (~34,000), again replaced on age roughly 5 years after the first set
Front brake pads + discs (~18,000) — first friction replacement in 10 years; regenerative braking spares the pads, so this is driven as much by disc corrosion as by wear
12V AGM auxiliary battery, second replacement (~10,000)
Super Long Life Coolant first change (~4,000) — a 160,000 km / ~10 year item, so triggered by the calendar
Brake fluid x2 (~4,000) and filters (~5,000)
Out-of-warranty repair reserve ~20,000: suspension bushings, A/C system service, water pump, rubber and seal ageing

EXCLUDED: hybrid battery replacement (~NT$150,000-200,000). Out of warranty after year 8, but at only 70,000 km the failure probability is low; a low-probability large cost is not loaded into the average. Treat it as tail risk, not budget.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average (~12,000-15,000 km/yr). All checkpoints use 7,000 km/year (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). Two consequences drive this whole model: (1) Servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven. Lexus Taiwan's published rule is 每6個月或每10,000公里，以先到者為準 (verified 2026-08-11 on lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx) — at 7,000 km/yr the 6-month clock always fires first, so the owner makes ~2 shop visits per year, ~20 over ten years, and the service LEVEL is set by the calendar rather than the odometer. (2) Consumables age out rather than wear out: tyres are replaced on age (~5-6 years) not tread, and brake pads last unusually long because the PHEV's regenerative braking does most of the stopping. Only spark plugs are genuinely outside the 10-year window — the official Lexus TW table places 自排變速箱油更換 in the 48個月/80,000公里 service, and because the calendar always fires first that service arrives at 48 months (28,000 km) and again at 96 months (56,000 km), i.e. TWICE inside the 10-year window. Spark plugs remain correctly excluded (the table's own note reads 一般車、油電車每10萬公里更換, and the car reaches only 70,000 km). Car is kept in Taiwan, garaged/home-charged, one owner, no accident history. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded by design. LOW MILEAGE IS ALSO THE SINGLE BIGGEST DRIVER OF THE RESIDUAL CURVE, and the 2026-08-11 re-research showed the prior draft had badly under-credited it: every 9-10 year-old 4th-gen RX450h currently listed in Taiwan carries 129,000-198,400 km, i.e. two to three times this car's 70,000 km at the same age, so raw asking prices for old RX450h stock describe a different car from this one and must be mileage-corrected upward before use. Note for context only: the 2,487 cc engine puts this car in the 2,401-3,000 cc bracket (牌照稅 15,210 + 燃料稅 7,200 = 22,410/yr) — materially cheaper than the 3.5 V6 predecessor's 3,456 cc bracket (28,220 牌照稅), one reason the new generation should hold value better than the old one.

purchase.source: LIST PRICE VERIFIED against two sources that agree exactly, re-confirmed 2026-08-11. (1) 8891 新車頻道's 2026 model-year Taiwan RX price table (c.8891.com.tw/news/lexus/rx/20732, published 2025-09-17), re-fetched today and re-read line by line: RX 350 豪華版 2,460,000 / RX 350 頂級版 2,680,000 / RX 350 旗艦版 2,950,000 / RX 350 F Sport 2,950,000 / RX 350h 豪華版 2,560,000 / RX 350h 頂級版 2,780,000 / RX 350h 旗艦版 3,050,000 / RX 450h+ 豪華版 3,150,000 / RX 450h+ 旗艦版 3,550,000 / RX 500h F Sport Performance 3,610,000, with the article stating 售價維持不變 for the 2026 model year. (2) lexus.com.tw/models/rx shows the RX range as NT$246萬~361萬, whose endpoints match that table's 2,460,000 low and 3,610,000 high exactly. DISCOUNT CORRECTED THIS PASS from 0 to 150,000 — see notes; the prior draft's 0 was an unverified application of the generic 'Lexus does not discount' heuristic and is contradicted by a dated, arithmetically self-consistent PTT 菜單 for this exact model line (ptt.cc/bbs/car/M.1745186843.A.277.html). real_cost = 3,150,000 - 150,000 + 40,000 = 3,040,000.
purchase.notes: DISCOUNT = 150,000, CHANGED FROM 0 THIS PASS. The prior draft asserted that 'Lexus Taiwan (和泰/Hotai) does not do cash discounts on the RX line' and set discounts = 0. That assertion is wrong, and a real deal sheet for this exact model line disproves it. PTT car board 菜單 [菜單] 正25年式25年出廠的Rx450h+旗艦版 (posted 2025-04-21, fetched and read in full 2026-08-11) itemises an RX 450h+ 旗艦版 deal as: 車價 355萬, 現金折讓 -15萬, 3M MA 系列隔熱紙 +2.1萬, 原廠鍍膜 +1.3萬, 總計 343.4萬 不含領牌稅金. The arithmetic checks exactly (3,550,000 - 150,000 + 21,000 + 13,000 = 3,434,000), which is the signature of a genuine quote rather than a recalled figure. Replies to that post treat 150,000 as a SMALL discount for this car ('這台折價還是這麼少喔？') and expect roughly another 100,000 in a 競賽月, so 150,000 is the conservative end of the observed range, not the optimistic end. 150,000 (4.8% of list) is applied to the 豪華版 as the like-for-like figure from the same model line and the same sales period. It deliberately stays FAR below the 260,000 (10.2%) the sibling RX 350h 豪華版 record carries from its own verified PTT 菜單: the 450h+ is the supply-constrained halo variant and genuinely discounts less than the volume 350/350h, which is exactly what the two 菜單 show side by side. What is NOT claimed is a zero discount — no evidence supports that. onroad_fees = 40,000, and the same 菜單 independently corroborates the magnitude: it shows 隔熱紙 21,000 + 鍍膜 13,000 = 34,000 of accessories paid on top of the car, with 領牌稅金 explicitly excluded and billed separately. Our 40,000 = 領牌 + 代辦 (新領牌照登記費, 號牌, 監理代辦) ~8,000 plus the ~32,000 accessory pack essentially every Taiwan luxury-SUV buyer takes at delivery (隔熱紙, 行車記錄器, 車身鍍膜, 腳踏墊/門檻條). Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded per the model's design. real_cost = 3,150,000 - 150,000 + 40,000 = 3,040,000.

items.name: 過戶費（監理規費 + 代辦）
售前整備／內外美容（洗車鍍膜、內裝清潔、輪圈整理）
8891 個人自售刊登 + 加值曝光費

selling_costs.notes: Assumes a private sale (自售) on 8891, which is the channel the private_sale_price figures represent. 過戶 regulatory fees themselves are small (a few hundred NTD of 規費); the 3,000 is mostly the 代辦 fee for having a 代辦 handle the monitoring-office paperwork. Detailing is set at the top of the normal range because a NT$1,500,000+ luxury SUV will not fetch its asking price without proper 售前整備. Total 13,000 sits in the upper half of the 4,000-15,000 band, appropriate for this class. If the owner instead trades in at a dealer these costs mostly disappear — but so does the private-vs-trade-in price gap, which is far larger. Not disputed in review and unchanged this pass.

value_checkpoints.source: NOT DISPUTED IN REVIEW — figures unchanged this pass, and the underlying listings were re-fetched 2026-08-11 and still stand. 8891 中古車 (auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx?page=1&sort=price-desc) today shows exactly three RX 450h+ 豪華版 cars: 2025款 1.0萬km 車商售價 2,488,000, 2024款 1.3萬km 2,488,000, 2024款 1.3萬km 2,488,000. The dedicated auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/rx450h page returns the same three cars and nothing else, confirming this is the entire national supply. Curve shape cross-checked against the far denser RX 350h 豪華版 set on the same page (list 2,560,000): 2026款 0.6萬km 2,288,000 = 89.4% of list, 2024款 2.4萬km 1,988,000 = 77.7%, 2024款 3.7萬km 1,988,000 = 77.7%. CAVEAT ON THE DIRECT COMPS (still true): all three 450h+ listings show the identical 2,488,000 across two model years and two mileages, which is the signature of a 刊登價 anchor rather than a real per-car curve. They fix the LEVEL of a 1-2 year old 450h+ (~2,490,000 asking) but cannot shape the year-on-year slope. Blending that level against the 350h curve level-shifted to this car's list price gives an evidence band of 2,488,000-2,670,000 for year-1 dealer asking; 2,600,000 taken, mid-band. THIS IS THE PARITY DATA POINT that governs the corrections made at years 5, 7 and 10 below: at 1-2 years the 450h+ asks 79.0% of its list (2,488,000 / 3,150,000) while the RX 350h 豪華版 asks 77.7% (1,988,000 / 2,560,000) — the PHEV holds at parity or very slightly better, not worse. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED (dealer asking is NOT the owner's proceeds): 車商售價 2,600,000 -12% = 自售價 2,290,000 (private_sale_price); 自售價 -13% = 車商收購價 1,990,000 (dealer_tradein_price). Two near-new outliers deliberately excluded as non-representative: abccar LEXUS CPO/南港 2024款 450h+ 豪華版 at 3,258,000 (全新車領牌未使用) and 東威汽車 2024款 at 2,888,000 (全新中獎車).

NOT DISPUTED IN REVIEW — figures unchanged this pass. The 5th-gen RX launched in Taiwan late November 2022, so 2023款 cars are genuinely ~3 years old today and this checkpoint rests on observed data rather than pure extrapolation. Re-verified on 8891 中古車 2026-08-11 (page 2 of the price-descending list): RX 350h 豪華版 (list 2,560,000) 2023款 4.02萬km 車商售價 1,758,000 (68.7% of list) and two 2023款 4.9萬km at 1,739,000 (67.9%). Our car carries 21,000 km, roughly half those, so a genuine low-mileage premium of ~4 points applies, giving ~72% mileage-adjusted dealer asking. No PHEV penalty is applied here, consistent with the year-1 parity finding above. The dealer-asking figure is held at ~2,170,000 rather than raised to the ~2,270,000 the mileage-adjusted ratio would support; that was originally done to avoid a kink against a year-5 point that has now been raised, so this checkpoint is now the CONSERVATIVE (low) end of its own evidence band rather than the middle. It is left unchanged because the reviewer did not dispute it and re-research produced no new year-3 evidence; the tension is recorded in the issues list for the cross-vehicle owner rather than silently patched. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 車商售價 2,170,000 -12% = 自售價 1,910,000; 自售價 -13% = 車商收購價 1,660,000.

RAISED THIS PASS from 1,545,000/1,345,000 — the reviewer's objection is sustained. EXTRAPOLATED: no genuine 5-year data for this car can exist (the 450h+ went on sale in Taiwan November 2022, so the oldest example is ~3.7 years old), so the predecessor 4th-gen RX450h (AL20, 3.5 V6 hybrid) is used, mileage-corrected, then discounted for PHEV-specific risk. PREDECESSOR ANCHORS AT 5 YEARS, all re-fetched 2026-08-11: 8891 page 2 shows 2021款 RX450h 頂級版 6.0萬km 車商售價 1,468,000 = 44.6% of its ~3,290,000 list; abc好車網 Car/2130376 shows a 2021年 RX450h 頂級版 at 1,728,000 = 52.5% (mileage not published); the 4-year point is bracketed above by abc好車網 Car/2146839, a LEXUS CPO/桃園 2022年 頂級版 at 1,998,000 = 60.7%. The 8891 car carries 60,000 km against our 35,000 km, worth roughly +5 points, lifting it to ~50%; the predecessor band mileage-matched to this owner is therefore ~50-55% of list. The 5th gen should sit above that band for two verified reasons: it is the generation still on sale, and its 2,487 cc engine pays 15,210 牌照稅 against the 3.5 V6 predecessor's 28,220, a 13,010/yr saving a used buyer prices in. The sibling RX 350h record lands the 5th-gen HEV at 62% of list on the same logic. WHAT CHANGED AND WHY: the prior draft took ~55% of real_cost and, worse, built its band from predecessor listings without correcting for their mileage, then subtracted a large unspecified PHEV penalty. The PHEV penalty applied here is deliberately SMALL at year 5 — 2.5 points, giving 59.5% of list — because at this age the 18.1 kWh traction battery is still comfortably inside its verified 8年/160,000公里 cover, so the specific risk Taiwanese buyers discount has not yet materialised, and because three independent local data sets show PHEVs at or above parity with their non-plug-in siblings at this age: (a) this record's own year-1 finding (450h+ 79.0% of list vs RX 350h 豪華版 77.7%); (b) Volvo XC60 T8 vs B5 on 8891 today — T8 Inscription 2020款 6.3萬km 1,188,000 and T8 Recharge Inscription 2021款 8.0萬km 1,180,000, against B5 R-Design 2020款 7.0萬km 985,000 and 2021款 8.0萬km 985,000, i.e. the plug-in asks ~200,000 MORE at the same age and comparable mileage; (c) Volvo XC90 T8 vs B5 on 8891 today — 2023款 T8 Recharge Ultimate 3.2萬km 2,398,000 against 2023款 B5 Ultimate 2.3萬km 2,050,000, plug-in higher again despite more mileage. A 12-point Taiwan PHEV penalty is not observable in any of these. 3,150,000 x 0.595 = 車商售價 ~1,875,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 1,875,000 -12% = 自售價 1,650,000; 自售價 -13% = 車商收購價 1,435,000. SHAPE NOTE, STATED HONESTLY: the implied depreciation rate between years 3 and 5 is shallower than between years 1 and 3. That is defensible for this specific car — it still carries 4年/120,000公里 plus the earned 5th year, so a 5-year-old example sells right at the edge of factory cover and the cliff falls just after this checkpoint, not before it — but part of it is also an artefact of year 3 being held at the low end of its band (see that checkpoint). Confidence stays low: the predecessor is a conventional hybrid, not a PHEV, so it cannot itself measure the plug-in discount.

RAISED THIS PASS from 1,180,000/1,025,000 — same objection, same method as year 5. EXTRAPOLATED; no 7-year-old 450h+ exists anywhere. The predecessor 4th-gen RX450h curve is anchored on the re-verified 5-year point above (~50% of list mileage-matched) and on the re-verified 9-10 year points below (~34.5% mileage-matched), which interpolates to ~42-43% dealer-asking retention for the predecessor at 7 years and 49,000 km. Applying the same 5th-gen uplift used at year 5 (current generation, 13,010/yr lower road tax) puts a 5th-gen HEV near the sibling RX 350h record's 50.5% of list. The PHEV discount is widened here to 2 points more than at year 5, giving 48.5% of list, for a reason that is specific and dated rather than a general 'thin PHEV demand' hand-wave: at year 7 the 18.1 kWh traction battery is one year from the end of its verified 8年/160,000公里 cover (lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx: 五年內或行駛100,000公里 factory + 和泰追加三年或60,000公里), and a buyer at this point is knowingly buying the last year of it. WHAT WAS WRONG BEFORE: the prior draft used 42% of real_cost, built by interpolating between a 5-year point that was itself too low and a 10-year point anchored on a single high-mileage listing (see year 10). Correcting both ends moves this point up with them. 3,150,000 x 0.485 = 車商售價 ~1,530,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 1,530,000 -12.5% = 自售價 1,340,000; 自售價 -13.5% = 車商收購價 1,160,000; the private-to-trade-in gap is widened slightly from the year-5 step because dealers price in longer lot time as cars age.

RAISED THIS PASS from 758,000/660,000. This is where the prior draft was most clearly wrong, and re-research identified the specific error: IT ANCHORED ON A SINGLE HIGH-MILEAGE LISTING AND CREDITED ONLY ~6 POINTS FOR MILEAGE. The prior anchor was a FindCar 2016年式 RX450h at 798,000 whose mileage is not published; the same FindCar page (re-fetched 2026-08-11) shows its neighbours are 2014年式 98,000 km at 458,000 and 2012年式 160,000 km at 298,000, i.e. that 798,000 car sits inside a high-mileage, bottom-of-market cohort. Fresh 8891 evidence re-fetched today makes the mileage problem explicit: EVERY 9-10 year-old 4th-gen RX450h currently listed carries 129,000-198,400 km — 2017款 旗艦版 12.9萬km at 928,000, 2017款 旗艦版 17.3萬km at 750,000, 2017款 標準版 19.84萬km at 688,000. There is no low-mileage 10-year comparable on the market at all, so the raw asking prices describe a car with two to three times our 70,000 km and cannot be used without a large upward correction. TWO INDEPENDENT METHODS SIZE THAT CORRECTION AND AGREE. (1) Intra-cohort mileage gradient: the matched 2017 旗艦版 pair differ by 44,000 km and 178,000 NTD (750,000 vs 928,000), i.e. ~4,050 NTD per 1,000 km; extending from 129,000 km down to 70,000 km at even half that gradient gives ~1,050,000 and at the full gradient ~1,167,000. (2) The sibling RX 350h record's independently verified abc好車網 anchors for the same predecessor generation on the same date — 2016 RX450h 旗艦版 at 1,188,000 and 2016 RX450h 頂級版 at 1,288,000 — land in the same place, and that record explicitly treats the FindCar 798,000 as the worn end of the spread rather than the anchor. A mileage-matched 10-year predecessor is therefore ~1,150,000-1,250,000, or ~34.5% of the 旗艦版's 3,440,000 list, NOT the 26.6% the prior draft used. Applying the year-5 uplift for the 5th gen puts a 5th-gen HEV near the sibling record's 37.5% of list, and the PHEV discount is widened to its maximum here — 4.5 points, giving 33% of list — because by year 10 the traction battery is TWO years outside its 8年/160,000公里 cover and Taiwan buyers discount that risk hard. That is a real and deliberately larger penalty than at years 5 and 7; what it is not is the ~12-point collapse the prior draft implied, which would have put a 3,150,000 Lexus below a 1,398,000 VW Tiguan at the same age with no local evidence offered for it. 3,150,000 x 0.33 = 車商售價 ~1,040,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 1,040,000 -12% = 自售價 915,000; 自售價 -16% = 車商收購價 770,000; the gap is widest here because a 10-year-old PHEV ties up a dealer's floor for months. REMAINING CAVEATS: the 4th-gen RX450h's ORIGINAL 2015/2016 launch prices could not be verified (8891's RX450h tag page, re-fetched today, confirms only the late-run 314萬起 豪華版 and 344萬 旗艦版, and the 頂級版 ~3,290,000 used above is interpolated between them), so every ratio here moves proportionally with that denominator; and the year 9-10 battery risk is priced as a discount to the whole car, not as a costed repair, because no Taiwan replacement-cost data for this pack exists yet. Treat as an order-of-magnitude estimate, not a forecast.

maintenance.plan_notes:
NOT DISPUTED IN REVIEW — this whole section is carried forward unchanged; re-research this pass was confined to the purchase price and the residual curve.

SERVICE IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN — VERIFIED. Lexus Taiwan's official schedule (lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx) is 每6個月或每10,000公里，以先到者為準, with escalating levels at 6個月/1萬km (16 items, oil + filter), 12個月/2萬km (29 items), 24個月/4萬km (34 items, brake fluid) and 48個月/8萬km (37 items, coolant AND 自排變速箱油更換). At 7,000 km/yr the 6-month clock ALWAYS fires first, so this owner makes about 2 shop visits per year — ~20 over ten years, roughly double what a 15,000 km/yr driver makes — and the service LEVEL is set by the calendar, never the odometer. That is why these numbers run above the manufacturer's headline figure. For reference, 風傳媒's cost analysis of the mechanically-related NX 450h+ 豪華版 (same 2.5L PHEV architecture) puts factory scheduled maintenance at NT$64,350 for 10 visits over 100,000 km; the same car on a 6-month calendar reaches only 70,000 km in 10 years but pays for ~20 visits. Both figures are right; they answer different questions.

NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE — VERIFIED. lexus.com.tw/service_warranty.aspx explicitly excludes 例行性保養之工資 and consumable parts (皮帶、雨刷片、燈泡、保險絲、煞車來令片…); only the 1-month first check is complimentary. Do not model this as a Volvo/Porsche-style included-service brand. What Lexus TW does offer is 新車保證 4年或120,000公里 (verified wording: 自交車日起4年或行駛120,000公里，以先到者為準), plus the 新車準時保養愛車享延長保證方案 — complete 8 consecutive on-time services using the official 定保套餐 and you get a free 5th year / +20,000 km of warranty. Eight services at 2/year is exactly 4 years, so this low-mileage owner qualifies naturally, which is why 2 paid visits/year are modelled through year 5 rather than letting the owner stretch to annual. The traction battery is separately covered 8年/160,000公里 — verified exact wording on lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx: HV 電池保證期限為自交車日起五年內或行駛100,000公里以內, plus 總代理和泰汽車追加三年或60,000公里，總計自交車日起八年或160,000公里. No HV battery replacement cost is modelled inside 10 years.

WHAT NEVER HAPPENS AT THIS MILEAGE. Spark plugs are genuinely outside the window: the official table's own note reads 一般車、油電車每10萬公里更換 and this car reaches only 70,000 km at year 10 — correctly NOT included. Transaxle fluid IS included, twice: the official table places 自排變速箱油更換 inside the 48個月/80,000公里 service, and since the calendar always fires first that service arrives at 48 months (28,000 km) and again at 96 months (56,000 km), so it is costed in the year-5 and year-10 windows. Brake pads last unusually long because regenerative braking does most of the deceleration; a first front-pad change is modelled around year 6-7, not year 4. Tyres are replaced on AGE (235/60R19, roughly every 5 years) rather than tread depth — 35,000 km would barely scuff a set.

COST BASIS: per-visit figures are built from owner-reported Lexus Taiwan receipts (Mobile01 and PTT car board: routine oil-change visits NT$3,750-5,000, annual/filter visits NT$6,000-9,000, big 4-year visits NT$12,000-15,000; the PTT thread also gives real part prices — 12V battery NT$8,700, tyres NT$6,800-7,000 each). RX-class parts price above the NX/IS cars in those threads and that premium is applied throughout. HONEST DOWNSIDE: an owner who drops to one visit a year after the warranty expires would cut the years 5-10 numbers by roughly 30%; conversely, dealer upselling (臭氧機, 清潔劑, 引擎室清洗) can inflate any single visit by several thousand NTD — the PTT thread shows owners paying ~NT$30,000 per visit once those items are accepted.

assumptions.notes: Taiwan market, private (non-commercial) owner driving 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000). That is roughly half the TW average (~12,000-15,000 km/yr), which matters twice. (1) Lexus Taiwan's published schedule is tier-based on 6個月/10,000公里 -> 12個月/20,000公里 -> 24個月/40,000公里 -> 48個月/80,000公里, 先到者為準 (verified on lexus.com.tw). At 7,000 km/yr the km trigger NEVER binds, so the schedule is entirely TIME-driven: two shop visits every year, and the mileage-coded items (變速箱油 at the 48個月/80,000公里 tier, spark plugs) arrive on age rather than wear. (2) The used-car pools are mileage-contaminated in opposite directions: the current-gen 350h 七人座 listings on 8891 cluster at 35,000 km, and the predecessor LM300h 七人座 pool is dominated by commercial VIP-shuttle cars at 49,000-160,000 km. Every resale figure below therefore carries an EXPLICIT low-mileage premium over the raw listing, quantified in each source string rather than asserted. Vehicle licence tax (牌照稅), fuel tax (燃料費) and insurance are excluded from every figure by design.

purchase.source: Official 2026年式 建議售價 NT$4,290,000, independently re-verified in this audit against FIVE sources on 2026-08-11: (1) lexus.com.tw model index shows the LM range as NT$429~596萬, i.e. 429萬 is the floor of the range; (2) Yahoo 汽車 MY2026 trim page — 350h 七人座 429 / 500h 六人座 459 / 350h 四人座 566 / 500h 四人座 596; (3) KingAutos LM hub — 350h 7人座 NT$4,290,000 explicitly; (4) 7Car road test of this exact trim — 429萬起; (5) SiCAR MY2026 article — LM350h 七人座 429萬 unchanged, only the two 四人座 trims rose NT$10,000. The researcher's figure was correct and is retained unchanged. The claimed automated mis-read that assigned 429 to the 500h 六人座 is definitively resolved: SiCAR itself, read directly, states 350h 七人座 429萬 and 500h 六人座 459萬.
purchase.notes: CORRECTED vs the researcher: onroad_fees reduced 55,000 -> 45,000, so real_cost 4,345,000 -> 4,335,000. Reason: the brief scales on-road fees from ~15,000 (mainstream, ~80-100萬 cars) to a ceiling of ~60,000 for Porsche (~600-900萬 cars). A 429萬 car sitting at 55,000 was riding almost at the Porsche ceiling; interpolated on price it belongs near 45,000. Build: 領牌費+規費 ~8,000 + 代辦費 ~5,000 + 交車配件 ~32,000 (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 迎賓踏板, 車美仕內裝套件). discounts = 0 is confirmed correct for this car: the brief itself puts Lexus in the no-discount group, and the LM is supply-constrained in TW (dealers compete on delivery slot, not cash), so a cash discount would be the anomaly. real_cost = 4,290,000 - 0 + 45,000 = 4,335,000. 牌照稅/燃料費/保險 excluded by design. Spec re-verified on 7Car and KingAutos: 2,487cc NA + motor, 250PS combined, AWD E-Four, 225/55R19 on 19-inch alloys — the trim string is accurate. This is the 7-seat entry model, NOT the 4-seat Executive (566萬).

selling_costs.notes: Reviewed and retained unchanged — this is correctly placed at the top of the brief's 4,000-15,000 band because it is a 400萬-class luxury MPV. 過戶費 itself is small (監理規費 ~700-1,000 plus agent fee); the detailing and the listing spend are the real cost. A ~5m-long MPV with rear captain's chairs, a headliner screen and a large glass area costs meaningfully more to prep than a sedan, and private buyers at this price point will not view a car that has not been fully detailed.

value_checkpoints.source: RETAINED after independent verification. I re-read 8891 myself on 2026-08-11 (both m.8891.com.tw/autos?brand=24&model=17248 and auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/lm) and the anchor listing is real and is almost exactly this buyer profile: 「Lexus LM 2026款 350h 7人座｜6,600公里｜399萬」 — ~1 year old at 6,600 km vs our assumed 7,000 km. That 3,990,000 is 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), not what an owner receives. PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = dealer retail -10% = 3,591,000, rounded to 3,600,000. The shallow end of the 8-15% band is used deliberately because LM demand in TW is strong enough that private sellers transact close to dealer asking. dealer trade-in (車商收購價) = private -11.1% = 3,200,000. Two higher-mileage listings on the same page corroborate the level and confirm this is the low-mileage end of the pool, exactly as the brief requires: 2025款 350h 7人座 / 35,000 km / 375.8萬 and 2024款 350h 7人座 / 35,600 km / 379.8萬.

CORRECTED UPWARD from the researcher's 3,220,000 / 2,850,000. Two defects were found. (a) Their stated anchor — 'a 2024款 350h 7人座 with only 5,298 km asking 378萬' — could NOT be reproduced when I re-read the same page (auto.8891.com.tw/lexus/lm) on 2026-08-11; the 2024款 350h 7人座 I can actually see is 35,600 km at 379.8萬. That anchor is treated as unverified and is not used. (b) They drew a straight line through mileage-blind listings and never applied the low-mileage premium the brief mandates, even though this checkpoint's 21,000 km is far below the 35,000 km at which the real listings sit. Rebuilt from the three VERIFIED current-gen 350h 七人座 listings: 1y/6,600 km = 399萬; ~2y/35,600 km = 379.8萬; ~1.5y/35,000 km = 375.8萬. The 2024款 asking MORE than the 2025款 at equal mileage shows age is nearly flat across that span and the 399萬-vs-378萬 gap is driven mostly by MILEAGE (~28,400 km apart). Taking the conservative half of that mileage coefficient and a -4%/yr age term gives ~370萬 dealer retail for a 3-year car at 21,000 km. PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = 3,700,000 -10% = 3,330,000; dealer trade-in = private -12% = 2,930,000. Note the reconciliation with the brief's '3-year retention 80%+ is real for LM/Alphard': at DEALER-RETAIL level this is 3,700,000/4,335,000 = 85%, comfortably above 80%; the private-sale figure lands at 77% only because the mandated private haircut is applied on top. No direct 3-year 七人座 listing exists, hence medium.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 5-year data exists for the current generation (2nd-gen LM went on sale in TW Aug-2023, max real age ~3.0 years). Predecessor method per the brief. CORRECTED: the researcher used 367萬 as the LM300h 七人座 list price, an unverified 'launch price' figure; the only price I can verify on their own cited source (c.8891.com.tw/feature/1603, read 2026-08-11) is LM300h 七人座 372萬 / 四人座 520萬, so 372萬 is used as the denominator. They also silently rounded 2,660,000 down to 2,600,000, an unexplained extra -2.2% on top of the stated method; that is removed. Predecessor data re-verified by me on 8891: 2021款 300h 7人座 / 49,000 km / 218萬, with the rest of the 7-seat pool at 199.8萬 (85,600 km), 229.8萬 (77,000 km, 2022款), 215.8萬 (110,000 km, 2023款) and 188萬 (160,000 km). Closest comparable is 49,000 km against our 35,000 km, so a +15% low-mileage/private-owner premium is applied (cross-checked: the current-gen mileage coefficient, scaled down to a 220萬 car, implies ~+16% for 14,000 fewer km — so +15% is calibrated, not arbitrary): 218萬 -> ~250萬 dealer-retail equivalent = 250/372 = 67.2% of the predecessor's list. Applied to real_cost 4,335,000 -> 2,913,000 retail-equivalent. PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = -10% = 2,620,000; dealer trade-in = private -11.5% = 2,320,000. Caveat stated plainly: the 1st-gen LM pool in TW is heavily commercial-shuttle stock and the 1st gen was the weaker, more niche product, so this base probably UNDERSTATES a genuinely low-mileage private 2nd-gen car — the current gen is running at only ~-5%/yr through year 2.5, far flatter than this ratio implies.

EXTRAPOLATED, and weaker than the 5-year figure — no LM of ANY generation is 7 years old in Taiwan yet (1st gen arrived in 2020, so the oldest cars on the market are ~6.5 years). Built by extending the corrected predecessor-derived curve at roughly -8%/yr of dealer retail from the 5-year retail-equivalent: 2,913,000 * 0.92^2 = ~2,460,000 retail-equivalent. PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = -10% = 2,210,000; dealer trade-in = private -11.5% = 1,960,000. Recomputed off the corrected 372萬 denominator and 4,335,000 real_cost, so it differs from the researcher's 2,260,000 / 2,000,000. Directional support only from the oldest real LM300h 七人座 listings on abc好車網 (2020年式 asking 312萬, verified to exist as a live listing) — that sits far above 8891's live market for comparable cars (188-230萬) and is treated as a probable stale posting, not as evidence. See issues: this conflict is the largest single uncertainty in the record.

EXTRAPOLATED with the least support of any checkpoint — the LM nameplate does not exist at 10 years old in Taiwan in either generation. Two-step method. (1) Continued the corrected predecessor-derived retail curve at -8%/yr: 2,460,000 * 0.92^3 = ~1,920,000 retail-equivalent (~44% of real_cost). (2) Absolute-level sanity check against the closest real 10-year luxury MPV in the same showroom family, Toyota Alphard 3rd gen 3.5 Executive Lounge, which I re-read on 8891 myself (auto.8891.com.tw/toyota/alphard, 2026-08-11): 2016年式 / 110,000 km / 138.0萬; 2017年式 / 101,100 km / 133.8萬; 2017年式 / 85,000 km / 136.8萬; 2015年式 / 120,000 km / 126.8萬; 2015年式 3.5 / 200,000 km / 119.8萬 — all dealer retail, all confirming the researcher's citation exactly. Our LM at 10 years carries only 70,000 km and started ~50% more expensive, so a retail-equivalent ~39% above those Alphard figures is coherent. PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private = retail-equivalent -12% = 1,690,000 (wider haircut than earlier years because price dispersion widens on old cars); dealer trade-in = private -12% = 1,490,000. Nothing here is a direct observation of a 10-year LM — treat as a modelled floor, not a quote. Note the Alphard cross-check arguably makes this conservative: those Alphards are holding ~50% of their original list at 10 years, above the ~44% modelled here.

maintenance.plan_notes: TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven. Verified directly on lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx (2026-08-11): the schedule runs 滿月 (free, 24-point check) -> 6個月/10,000公里 (16 points, engine oil) -> 12個月/20,000公里 (29 points, fluids + filters) -> 24個月/40,000公里 (34 points, 煞車油更換) -> 48個月/80,000公里 (37 points, 變速箱油更換), 先到者為準. At 7,000 km/yr the km side NEVER triggers, so this owner pays for two visits a year purely on the calendar — roughly double the visit count of a 15,000 km/yr owner, and the dominant reason maintenance here looks expensive for the mileage. NO free scheduled maintenance in Taiwan: the official page publishes no prices and bundles nothing beyond the free 滿月 check, so every figure below is out of pocket. Warranty structure, verified on lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx: 新車保固 4年或120,000公里 (so periods 1 and 3 carry zero repair cost, and period 5 is covered for its first year); 油電池 5年/100,000公里 plus a Hotai-added 3年/60,000公里 = 8年/160,000公里 total (so the single biggest hybrid risk item is covered right through the 7-year checkpoint and expires inside the 7-10y window); 自費更換正廠零件 2年/50,000公里; 延長保證 available. COST CAVEAT, unchanged and important: no LM-specific dealer receipt exists anywhere I could reach. Every NT$ figure below is scaled up from Taiwanese owner-reported Lexus 定保 costs on smaller models (ES200 半年保 5,000-10,000; NX200 基本定保含工資 6,900, 12,000 with extras; UX hybrid 3,000 first then 6,000) to flagship-MPV level: ~7,000 per 6-month minor, ~13,000 per 12-month annual. Tyre size for costing is 225/55R19 on 19-inch alloys (confirmed on both 7Car and KingAutos for this exact trim).

major_items: 滿月保養（新車檢查，24項，免費）
6個月定保：引擎機油、機油芯、16項檢查（~7,000）
12個月定保：機油、機油芯、空氣濾網、冷氣濾網、29項檢查（~13,000）
保固期內（4年/120,000公里），無自費維修支出
checkpoints.source: Interval and tier content verified directly on the official Lexus Taiwan 定期保養 page (lexus.com.tw/service/maintenance-plan.aspx); that page publishes NO prices, so pricing is scaled from Taiwanese Lexus owner reports of 半年保 costs on ES/NX/UX up to flagship-MPV level. Two paid visits in year one: ~7,000 + ~13,000 = 20,000. Covers 0-1y.

major_items: 4次定保（2次半年保 + 2次年度定保），covers 1-3y only
24個月定保：煞車油更換、34項檢查
油電動力控制冷卻系統檢查（hybrid item at the 24個月 tier）
冷氣濾網、雨刷片更換
仍在 4年/120,000公里 新車保固內，無自費維修
checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE the 1-year checkpoint (covers 1-3y), not cumulative. Four visits at the official 6-month cadence at ~7,000/13,000 alternating = 40,000, plus ~8,000 for the 24個月 tier 煞車油, 冷氣濾網 and wipers. The 24個月 tier is reached on TIME (month 24) not on km — 21,000 km is only half the tier's 40,000 km trigger. Pricing scaled from owner-reported Lexus TW 定保 costs, not an LM receipt.

major_items: 4次定保（covers 3-5y）
48個月定保：變速箱油更換、煞車油、空氣濾網、油電動力控制冷卻系統、37項檢查 — reached on AGE (month 48) at 35,000 km, less than half the tier's 80,000 公里 trigger
第一組輪胎更換 225/55R19 x4 + 四輪定位（~36,000）— AGE-driven at 5 years, not tread wear: 35,000 km leaves plenty of tread, but 5-year-old rubber on a ~2.4-tonne MPV should go
12V 輔助電瓶第一次更換（~8,000）
新車保固 4年/120,000公里 於本區間第4年到期，第5年起開始有自費維修風險
checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE the 3-year checkpoint (covers 3-5y). CORRECTED from the researcher's 95,000, and the 變速箱油 item was moved here from their 7-year window: the official table codes 變速箱油更換 to the 48個月/80,000公里 tier, and at 7,000 km/yr that tier lands on month 48 = year 4, which falls inside THIS window, not 5-7y. Build-up: 4 定保 = 40,000; 48個月 tier extras (煞車油, 空氣濾網, 油電動力控制冷卻系統) = 6,000; 變速箱油／eCVT 傳動油 = 6,000; first tyre set 225/55R19 x4 + alignment = 36,000; 12V battery = 8,000; small out-of-warranty contingency for the final year = 5,000. Warranty lapses at year 4 here, so year 5 is the first year with any own-cost repair exposure — kept modest given Toyota/Lexus hybrid reliability.

major_items: 4次定保（covers 5-7y），全數自費、已無新車保固
前後煞車來令片更換 + 碟盤整修（~25,000）— regenerative braking stretches pad life a long way at this mileage, but 6-7 years of age brings them due
電動滑門滑軌與馬達整修（~15,000）— the known LM/Alphard wear point; power sliding doors are this segment's characteristic ageing failure
冷氣濾網、空氣濾網、雨刷片（~5,000）
保固外維修預備（~20,000）— first window with NO new-car warranty cover at all
油電主電池仍在 8年/160,000公里 保固內 — the single largest risk item is still covered at this checkpoint
checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE the 5-year checkpoint (covers 5-7y). CORRECTED from the researcher's 90,000, which was LOWER than their own 5-year figure and broke the 'generally rises with age' requirement. The fix is substantive, not cosmetic: the 3-5y window still had one year of 新車保固 cover, whereas 5-7y is the FIRST window entirely outside it, so a real out-of-warranty contingency belongs here — 20,000 over two years on a 400萬-class MPV is modest. Build-up: 4 定保 = 40,000; brakes = 25,000; sliding-door mechanism = 15,000; filters/wipers = 5,000; out-of-warranty contingency = 20,000. The eCVT/變速箱油 item the researcher placed here was moved to the 5-year window (48個月 tier = year 4). Hybrid battery coverage (5年/100,000公里 + Hotai's added 3年/60,000公里 = 8年/160,000公里, verified on lexus.com.tw/owners-warranty.aspx) is why no battery reserve appears in this window — it does not lapse until after year 8, and at 49,000 km the km limit is nowhere near.

major_items: 6次定保（covers 7-10y，three years at two visits/year）
96個月（第8年）定保：第二次變速箱油更換（~6,000）
第二組輪胎 225/55R19 x4 + 定位（~36,000）— again age-driven, the year-5 set times out around year 10-11
12V 輔助電瓶第二次更換（~8,000）
引擎冷卻液與逆變器冷卻液更換（~12,000）— Toyota SLLC hits its 10-year service point in this window
銥合金火星塞更換（~10,000）— 10-year interval reached on age, not on the 70,000 公里
避震器、防傾桿襯套等老化底盤件（~25,000）
油電系統電池冷卻風扇清潔與健檢（~5,000）
高齡電裝品與電池自費風險預備（~10,000）— 油電主電池 8年/160,000公里 保固於第8年到期，第9-10年起電池本身進入自費風險
checkpoints.source: Cost SINCE the 7-year checkpoint (covers 7-10y — a THREE-year window, hence the larger figure). Build-up: 6 定保 = 60,000; 96個月 變速箱油 = 6,000; tyres 36,000; 12V battery 8,000; coolants 12,000; spark plugs 10,000; suspension/bushings 25,000; hybrid cooling service 5,000; ageing-electronics + post-warranty battery contingency 10,000 = 172,000, rounded to 170,000. Note this is a hybrid, so there is no timing belt, no turbo, and the 七人座 is the entry grade with conventional (non-air) suspension — the German out-of-warranty risk items do not apply. The corresponding LM risk is the hybrid main battery, whose 8年/160,000公里 warranty expires inside this window.

assumptions.notes: Owner drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). A mild hybrid cannot drive on electricity alone, so it takes the identical oil/filter/spark-plug service as a plain petrol car; the only extra long-term risk item is the 48V BSG and its DC/DC converter. Do not apply a hybrid maintenance discount. Vehicle is the 3rd-generation Tiguan, Taiwan launch 2025-06-12; the 26年式 (MY26) update was announced 2026-01-09. Because the generation is only ~14 months old in Taiwan, no genuine 3/5/7/10-year data exists for it; those checkpoints are extrapolated from the 2nd-generation Tiguan (and at 10 years the 1st generation), expressed as a retention ratio of that car's own original list price. WARRANTY (verified 2026-08-11 on vw.com.tw): VW Taiwan's standard new-car warranty is 2 years with no mileage limit, plus extended coverage running months 25-48 — i.e. cover ends at 4 years, NOT 5. The optional paid Give Me Five+ package is what pushes warranty to year 5; it is not modelled here. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅/貨物稅) and insurance are excluded by design throughout — this means the NT$50,000 舊換新貨物稅減免 that appears on real dealer menus is deliberately NOT counted as a discount.

purchase.notes: discounts = 110,000: VW Taiwan is a habitual discounter and the August 2026 factory campaign already prices the base car at 1,298,000, so 100,000 is available before any negotiation; the extra 10,000 reflects the dealer-level sweetener visible on shared menus. Deliberately NOT counted as a discount: the NT$50,000 舊換新貨物稅減免 (old-for-new commodity-tax rebate) shown on real menus — it is a tax item and this model excludes tax. onroad_fees = 25,000 for a ~1.4M imported European SUV: 領牌規費 + 代辦 roughly 8,000-10,000 (real menus list 領牌費 as 依單據實支實付), plus ~15,000 of owner-paid accessories beyond the gifted film/dashcam (行車紀錄器升級差額, 全車踏墊 + 行李廂墊, 晴雨窗, 鍍膜/E-Tag 框). Insurance (乙式全險 ~43,000-50,000/yr on the same menus) is excluded by design. real_cost = 1,398,000 - 110,000 + 25,000 = 1,313,000.

value_checkpoints.source: VERIFIED AND RETAINED. 8891 中古車 current-generation listings (auto.8891.com.tw/volkswagen/tiguan, re-read 2026-08-11): a 2026 280 eTSI Elegance with 161 km at 車商售價 1,159,000 (領牌/展示車), and 2025 280 eTSI Elegance Premium cars at 車商售價 1,058,000-1,075,000 with ~18,000 km = 70-71% of that trim's 1,508,000 list. Cross-check on the closest same-generation comparable: that Premium at 1,075,000 dealer retail, less 11% to reach private sale = 957,000, is 63.4% of its own 1,508,000 list; applying 63.4% to this car's 1,398,000 gives 886,000 at ~18,000 km, then +5% because 7,000 km is roughly half the mileage a normal 1-year-old carries -> 930,000. The 920,000 figure is within 1% of that independent derivation, so it stands. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 車商售價 (dealer retail asking) ~1,035,000 -> private_sale_price 920,000 (-11%) -> dealer_tradein_price 800,000 (-13% off private). One listing at 859,000 / ~30,400 km was set aside; note the researcher justified this as a "heavy-use car", which does not hold at that mileage — a 事故車 or bait listing is the likelier explanation, so it is excluded on grounds of being unexplainable rather than high-mileage. This is the only checkpoint with genuine current-generation data.

CORRECTED DOWN from 800,000/700,000. Extrapolated from the PREDECESSOR (2nd-gen) Tiguan at the same age, since the current generation only reached Taiwan in June 2025. Real 3-year-old dealer-retail listings read 2026-08-11: SUM 汽車網 2023 280 TSI Elegance 798,000 at 39,850 km and 798,000 at 41,073 km (758,000 at 80,750 km); SUM's whole 2023 band is 798,000-1,128,000, so 798,000 is the base-trim floor, which is the right anchor for a 280 Elegance. Against that car's ~1,348,000 list, 798,000 = 59.2% dealer-retail retention at ~40,000 km — note 40,000 km at 3 years is ABOUT AVERAGE for Taiwan, not high. WHY THE CORRECTION: the researcher stated a 59-62% band but then carried the 62% top of it into the calculation, reaching ~65% after the low-mileage premium; both actual data points give 59.2%. Redone: 59.2% x 1.06 (low-mileage premium for our 21,000 km, roughly half the comparables') = 62.8% applied to 1,398,000 -> 車商售價 ~878,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 878,000 dealer retail -> private_sale_price 780,000 (-11%) -> dealer_tradein_price 680,000 (-13% off private).

CORRECTED DOWN from 680,000/590,000 — the researcher cherry-picked one source. Extrapolated from the 2nd-gen facelift (2021 model year, 280 TSI Elegance, 建議售價 1,298,000 per U-CAR's 2021-04 launch report). Real 5-year-old dealer-retail listings read 2026-08-11: SUM 汽車網 2021 280 TSI Elegance 659,000 at 86,834 km and 2021 280 TSI 648,000 at 59,445 km (SUM's 2021 band floor is 558,000); 8891 shows 2021 280 TSI cars at 458,000-539,000 with 70,000-129,000 km. WHY THE CORRECTION: the researcher used only SUM's 659,000 and dismissed the 8891 cluster as "high mileage", but SUM's 659,000 car is 86,834 km — squarely inside the 8891 cars' 70,000-129,000 km range, so the two sets are comparable and the cheap ones cannot be excluded on mileage. Blending Elegance-grade stock across both sources gives ~610,000 dealer retail at ~80,000 km = 47.0% of the 1,298,000 list, not the 50.5% used. Redone: 47.0% x 1.09 (low-mileage premium for our 35,000 km, well under half the comparables') = 51.2% applied to 1,398,000 -> 車商售價 ~716,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 716,000 dealer retail -> private_sale_price 635,000 (-11%) -> dealer_tradein_price 550,000 (-13% off private). Note the car is OUT of factory warranty by this point (VW TW cover ends at 48 months), which is part of why the year 5-7 segment falls steeply.

EXTRAPOLATED, corrected slightly down from 480,000/415,000 — no genuine 7-year data exists for the current generation (Taiwan launch June 2025). Method: take the predecessor generation at 7 years old, express it as a retention ratio of ITS OWN original list price, then apply that ratio to this car's list. Real dealer-retail listings read 2026-08-11: 8891 2019 Tiguan 330 TSI at 438,000-498,000 with 60,000-113,000 km; SUM 2020 280 TSI Elegance 478,000 at 93,967 km; 8891 2020 280 TSI Elegance 488,000 and 2020 330 TSI Elegance 498,000-559,000. WHY THE CORRECTION: the researcher divided the 438,000-498,000 cars by a 1,328,000 denominator, but most of those are 330 TSI trims whose original list was far higher (~1,538,000), which inflates the implied retention. The closest-trim data point is the 2020 280 TSI Elegance at 478,000 / 93,967 km = ~37% of its 1,298,000 list at 6 years; stepping one more year down gives ~33.5% at ~100,000 km. Redone: 33.5% x 1.11 (low-mileage premium for our 49,000 km, about half a normal 7-year-old's odometer) = 37.2% applied to 1,398,000 -> 車商售價 ~520,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 520,000 dealer retail -> private_sale_price 465,000 (-11%) -> dealer_tradein_price 405,000 (-13% off private). Confidence low: cross-generation extrapolation, and the 3rd gen's software-heavy interior may age worse than the 2nd gen's physical switchgear.

EXTRAPOLATED — no 10-year data can exist for this generation, so the ratio comes from the OLDEST Tiguans actually on sale in Taiwan today (1st gen / early 2nd gen), read 2026-08-11: 8891 2017 330 TSI Highline 110,000-124,300 km -> 399,000-418,000, 2018 280 TSI Comfortline 57,200 km -> 428,000; FindCar 2016 1.4 TSI -> 385,000 and 2015 1.4 TSI -> 398,000. Against 8891's recorded original new-price bands for those years (2016: 1,148,000-1,308,000; 2017: 1,088,000-1,568,000) that is a ~26-33% dealer-retail retention. Took ~28.6% (mid-band, nudged up because 70,000 km at 10 years is exceptionally low — most comparables show 110,000 km+) applied to 1,398,000 -> 車商售價 ~400,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 400,000 dealer retail -> private_sale_price 355,000 (-11%) -> dealer_tradein_price 310,000 (-13% off private; corrected from 305,000 to keep the -13% step consistent with every other checkpoint). Confidence low: two generations removed, FindCar does not publish mileage on these listings, and at 10 years price is driven far more by service history and DSG condition than by the odometer.

maintenance.plan_notes: INTERVAL IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN at this usage. VW Taiwan's standard schedule is 1 year or 15,000 km whichever comes first, so at 7,000 km/year the clock always triggers first — one service per year, and the car reaches an interval's mileage only about every other year. VW Taiwan does offer 長里程彈性保養 (LongLife, option code QI6/QG1, long-life synthetic oil plus an oil-quality sensor) stretching petrol cars to a maximum of 2 years / 30,000 km; this plan assumes the conservative annual service, because Taiwan's short-trip, hot, humid duty cycle is exactly the condition under which oil degrades by time rather than distance, and because a 2-year-oil service book is a resale liability. WARRANTY (verified on vw.com.tw 2026-08-11, and CORRECTED from the researcher's version): the standard new-car warranty is 2 years with no mileage limit plus extended coverage across months 25-48 — cover ends at FOUR years. The researcher's year-7 note called that window "the first outside the 5-year warranty", which is wrong: 5-year cover exists only if the buyer pays for Give Me Five+ (roughly NT$1,399/month x 48 for Tiguan-class cars, ~67,000 total, prepaying 4 years / 60,000 km of scheduled maintenance and extending warranty to year 5). That package is NOT modelled, so this car is out of warranty from year 4 — which is why the years 3-5 window now carries a small repair-risk provision it previously lacked. No free-maintenance program is assumed. Costs are pay-as-you-go 原廠 (dealer) prices; a good 外廠 after warranty typically cuts the years 5-10 numbers by 30-40%, but that is not assumed. Big-ticket items land in the 7- and 10-year windows because that is when a German SUV's DSG oil, spark plugs, brakes, water pump and coil packs all come due together outside warranty.

checkpoints.source: Covers 0-1y. The itemised PTT car-board VW Taiwan dealer receipt list (VERIFIED by direct fetch 2026-08-11) shows a basic oil-and-filter interval at NT$7,686; Mobile01 VW owner threads put Tiguan annual service at NT$6,000-8,000. Tiguan sits one class above the Golf in that receipt list, so ~8,000 plus consumables. Car is fully inside the 2-year unlimited-mileage factory warranty; no wear parts due. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from high to medium: the one verifiable itemised receipt is for a Golf SV DIESEL (its intervals carry a diesel filter and additive instead of spark plugs), the Mobile01 corroboration is a search-result summary only (mobile01 returns 403 to direct fetch), and VW Taiwan publishes no official maintenance price table — so this does not meet the "several real listings or an official table" bar for high.

checkpoints.source: Covers 1-3y: two annual services. Base service ~8,500 each from the verified PTT dealer-receipt list (NT$7,686 / 8,328 per interval on a Golf SV; Tiguan runs slightly higher) plus Mobile01's 6,000-8,000/yr figure. Brake fluid is the one strictly time-based item — due at 2 years regardless of mileage, and the PTT list prices a brake-fluid-inclusive interval at NT$7,783. Still inside warranty for this whole window (2 years unlimited + extension through month 48), so no repair-risk provision. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from high to medium for the same reason as year 1: the only itemised receipt is a different model and fuel type, and there is no official VW Taiwan price table.

煞車油更換 (第 2 次，年 4)
四條輪胎更換 (~235/50R19 或 235/55R18)，5 年老化到期而非磨耗到期

checkpoints.source: Covers 3-5y. RAISED from 57,000 to 65,000. Two annual services (~10,000 + ~9,000) on the verified PTT/Mobile01 dealer-price basis. The step up is consumables, not labour: at 7,000 km/yr the original tyres reach 5 years with only 35,000 km on them, so they are replaced on AGE (sidewall hardening/cracking), not tread — four 19-inch premium tyres fitted in Taiwan run NT$24,000-32,000, budgeted 28,000. The 48V mild hybrid's main 12V battery is an AGM unit (start-stop duty), NT$8,000-10,000 fitted, and short low-mileage trips are the worst case for battery life. WHY THE INCREASE: VW Taiwan's warranty ends at 48 months (verified), not the 5 years the researcher assumed, so year 5 of this window is the car's first UNWARRANTED year and now carries an ~8,000 repair-risk provision (sensors, bushings, minor electrical) that the original record omitted entirely. Tyre and battery prices are Taiwan market ranges rather than a single sourced receipt, hence medium.

major_items: 2 x 年度定保
DSG 變速箱油 + 濾芯更換 (6 萬 km / 6 年)
火星塞更換 (1.5 TSI evo2，約 6 萬 km)

checkpoints.source: Covers 5-7y — the first FULL window outside factory warranty (CORRECTED: VW Taiwan cover is 2 years unlimited plus an extension through month 48, so warranty lapsed in year 4, not year 5 as the researcher wrote; the 5-year figure applies only if Give Me Five+ was purchased, which this plan does not assume). This is where the German-SUV bills start. The verified PTT VW Taiwan dealer receipt list prices the DSG-transmission-oil interval at NT$16,880 — by far the biggest scheduled line — and Mobile01's Tiguan thread records a NT$44,800 大保養 once transmission oil, plugs, belts and brakes coincide. Budget: ~20,000 (DSG oil service) + ~13,000 (service + spark plugs) + ~20,000 (front pads and discs at 原廠) + ~4,000 (coolant) + ~15,000 risk provision for the EA211 water-pump/thermostat housing and coil packs, both documented recurring VW failures at this age. This trim has steel springs, not air suspension, so there is no air-strut exposure; DCC adaptive dampers, if optioned, would add risk here.

major_items: 3 x 年度定保 (含 2 次煞車油)
第二套輪胎 (再次因老化而非磨耗)
後煞車來令片 + 碟盤
12V AGM 電瓶 (第 2 次)
火星塞 (第 2 次) + DSG 變速箱油 (第 2 次)
懸吊襯套/避震器、引擎腳
保固外風險準備：水幫浦、渦輪電子致動器、PCV、48V BSG 皮帶啟動馬達與 DC/DC
checkpoints.source: Covers 7-10y. EXTRAPOLATED from the pattern of high-mileage VW Taiwan owner receipts rather than a matching 10-year low-mileage case, so treat as an envelope not a quote. Anchors: Mobile01's NT$44,800 single 大保養 on a Tiguan at 120,000 km, and the verified PTT list showing NT$49,777 of purely scheduled work across 75,000 km. Build-up: ~30,000 for three annual services, ~30,000 for the second tyre set (again age-driven at this mileage), ~15,000 rear brakes, ~9,000 AGM battery, ~20,000 for second spark plugs plus second DSG service, ~20,000 suspension bushings/dampers and engine mounts, ~26,000 risk provision for out-of-warranty electrical and cooling failures including the 48V BSG/DC-DC hardware, which has no cheap aftermarket path. A well-treated low-mileage car could land nearer 100,000; one unlucky mechatronic or turbo failure blows past 200,000.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr, well under the TW average of ~12,000-15,000 km/yr. Midpoint 7,000 km/yr used at every checkpoint (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). Two consequences: (1) servicing is entirely TIME-driven — the TW interval is 1 year or 15,000 km, and at 7,000 km/yr the year always arrives first, so km-based items get pulled forward by age not distance; (2) resale sits modestly above the mileage-blind 行情 average. CORRECTION vs the prior draft: the size of that resale premium was overstated. The live 8891 T7 pool is NOT 'commercial-profile 26,000 km/yr cars' — the 2024-model Life cars carrying 26,000-27,200 km are ~2 years old in Aug 2026, i.e. roughly 13,000-16,000 km/yr, which is simply the TW average. The low-mileage premium over those listings is therefore small (a few points), not the large premium previously assumed, and it fades further with age: the T5 evidence shows an 11-year-old car with only 9,500 km still asking just 728,000. Powertrain confirmed gasoline against the official volkswagen-commercial.com.tw model page (Life and Style both 2.0 TSI 204PS; only TDI is diesel; no eHybrid imported).

purchase.notes:
Trim identification: Multivan / Life (T7, 2.0 TSI 204PS, 7-seat) — MY26. Taiwan does NOT import the eHybrid PHEV; the TW lineup is Life 2.0 TSI / Style 2.0 TSI / TDI 2.0 diesel 150PS, so powertrain is gasoline
list_price 2,100,000 is the MY26 Life, the model year currently on sale (launched Dec 2025). TW list-price history, cross-checked on FindCar: 2023 Life 1,998,000 / 2024 Life 2,038,000 / MY26 2,100,000 (2023 Style 2,478,000 / 2024 Style 2,498,000 / MY26 Style 2,570,000). onroad_fees 28,000 = 領牌/驗車規費 ~6,000 + 代辦費 ~4,000 + 配件 ~18,000 (window film across a large glass area, dashcam, floor mats, delivery detailing on a ~5.0 m vehicle). Tax (牌照稅/燃料費/貨物稅) and insurance (強制險/任意險) are EXCLUDED by design. real_cost = 2,100,000 - 120,000 + 28,000 = 2,008,000. CAVEAT ON discounts: the only non-cash component the 8891 page actually names is the 貨物稅補助; it does not itemise financing or accessory bundles. 120,000 is a deliberately conservative read of a 300,000 headline on a slow-moving 210萬 van, and the true cash figure could plausibly run to 180,000. Kept unchanged because no observed 菜單/transaction price could be sourced.

value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN from a prior draft's 1,570,000. Live 8891 T7 Multivan listings re-fetched 2026-08-11. The prior draft asserted 'dealer retail asking sits at ~84% of list at a genuine 1 year / 7,000 km' and attributed that to the 2025 Style with 7,000 km asking 1,938,000 — but that ratio does not compute: against the Style list (2024 2,498,000 / MY26 2,570,000, so MY25 ~2,520,000) 1,938,000 is 77%, not 84%. The other true 1-year comparable, a 2025 Life with 19,000 km asking 1,480,000, is 72% of the ~2,050,000 MY25 Life list. NOTE the prior draft misdated this car as a 2024; the live page shows 2025. Those two ~1-year points (72-77%) sit BELOW the three 2024 Life cars at 1,638,000-1,680,000 (80-82% of the 2,038,000 MY24 list), which is internally impossible — a 2-year car cannot out-retain a 1-year car. The 1,638,000-1,680,000 cluster is most likely sticky aspirational asking on a thin, slow-turning van market. Resolved by taking dealer retail asking at ~81% of list = ~1,700,000 (just above the 2-year cluster, well below the 91% near-new point set by the 2025 Style with 21 km at 2,288,000). ADJUSTMENT MADE (dealer-retail trap): private_sale_price = dealer asking x 0.89 (-11%, mid of the 8-15% dealer-retail-to-private gap) = 1,510,000; dealer_tradein_price = private x 0.87 (-13%) = 1,315,000. Small low-mileage credit only — see assumptions.notes for why the prior draft's premium was overstated. Confidence DOWNGRADED to low because the same-trim comparables contradict each other.

Live 8891 T7 Multivan Life cluster, re-fetched 2026-08-11 — genuine current-generation same-trim data at ~2 years: 2024 Life 26,000 km asking 1,638,000; 2024 Life 27,000 km asking 1,680,000; 2024 Life 27,200 km asking 1,680,000; 2024 2.0TSI 33,000 km asking 1,458,000 (cross-checked on FindCar: 2024 T7 TSI Life 26,914 km at 1,638,000). Mean ~1,614,000 on the 2,038,000 MY24 list = ~79% dealer retail asking at 2 years. CORRECTION: these are ~13,000-16,500 km/yr cars (2024 model year, ~2 years old in Aug 2026), i.e. the TW average — NOT the 26,000 km/yr commercial-use profile the prior draft claimed, so only a small low-mileage credit is warranted for our 21,000 km car, not a large one. Rolled the curve forward one year at the ~6-7 pts/yr German-van fade, net of that small credit, to ~71% of the 2,100,000 list = ~1,500,000 dealer retail asking. ADJUSTMENT MADE (dealer-retail trap): private = x 0.89 = 1,335,000; trade-in = private x 0.87 = 1,160,000. Copying the 1,638,000 asking price straight in would have overstated the owner's recovery by ~300,000.

EXTRAPOLATED — the T7 generation only reached TW in Oct 2022, so no genuine 5-year T7 exists. Bridged between the real ~2-year T7 Life data above (~79% dealer retail asking) and the real 7-year T6 evidence below (~49-50%), giving ~58% of the 2,100,000 list = ~1,220,000 dealer retail asking. ADJUSTMENT MADE (dealer-retail trap): private = dealer asking x 0.89 = 1,085,000; trade-in = private x 0.87 = 945,000. Shaded slightly conservative because the TW T7 Life is a GASOLINE 2.0 TSI while the used-van demand pool (commercial/shuttle buyers) prefers diesel — every T6/T5 comparable available is diesel. Consistent with the VW/German pattern of faster loss than the market, front-loaded into the early years.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM PREDECESSOR GENERATION — no 7-year-old T7 exists. Live 8891 T6 Multivan listings re-fetched 2026-08-11 and confirmed accurate as cited: 2019 T6 2.0 TDI Comfortline 19,000 km (19,963 km per FindCar) asking 1,228,000 = 54.4% of the T6 Comfortline 2,258,000 list; 2019 T6 LWB 95,000 km asking 950,000 = 42.1%; 2018 T6 LWB 250,000 km asking 739,000 = 32.7%. Interpolating on mileage to our 49,000 km car gives ~49-50% dealer retail asking at 7 years. CORRECTION vs the prior draft: a fourth T6 listing it cited as a plain '2019 with 80,000 km asking 1,150,000' is in fact a 福祉車 (wheelchair-accessible conversion) — a different segment with a different original price — and has been excluded as a comparable. Also, the petrol-vs-diesel penalty the prior draft applied at year 5 was not carried through here; applied consistently it takes the ratio to ~47.5% = ~1,000,000 dealer retail asking (every T6 comparable is a diesel, which the TW commercial used pool prefers). ADJUSTMENT MADE (dealer-retail trap): private = x 0.89 = 890,000; trade-in = private x 0.87 = 775,000. Sense-check against real_cost (2,008,000): 890,000 = 44% of what the owner actually paid.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM PREDECESSOR GENERATIONS — no 10-year T7 exists. CORRECTED DATA: the prior draft cited the T5 comparables at 10x their real mileage. The live 8891 T5 page (re-fetched 2026-08-11) shows the 2015 T5 Multivan 2.0 TDI asking 728,000 with 9,500 km — not '95,000 km' — and the 2012 T5 asking 398,000 with 29,000 km, not '290,000 km'. That inverts the reasoning: these are age-cheap, not mileage-cheap cars, which shows that by year 10 AGE dominates and the low-mileage premium the record leans on earlier has largely evaporated. An 11-year-old T5 with essentially no mileage still only asks 728,000 dealer retail; a 14-year-old with 29,000 km asks 398,000. Two anchors: (a) that 728,000 absolute floor for a near-unused 11-year T5; (b) extending the corrected T6 curve (~47.5-50% at 7 years) at the typical -4 to -5 pts/yr TW van fade to ~33% at 10 years = ~690,000. Both converge on ~690,000 dealer retail asking. ADJUSTMENT MADE (dealer-retail trap): private = x 0.90 = 620,000; trade-in = private x 0.86 = 535,000 (the trade-in gap widens on 10-year German vans because dealers price in reconditioning and slow turn). The third T5 listing (2014, 180,000 km, 600,000) is confirmed accurate. Weak, thin data — low confidence.

maintenance.plan_notes: TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven, at this buyer's usage. The TW Multivan 2.0 TSI service interval is 1 year or 15,000 km, whichever comes first; at 7,000 km/yr the calendar always triggers first, so the owner pays for a full service every year while accumulating half the mileage the interval was designed around. (VW Taiwan's 長里程彈性保養 / LongLife page — fetched and confirmed 2026-08-11 — does allow up to 2 years or 30,000 km on LongLife-coded QI6/QG1 petrol and diesel cars, but eligibility depends on the individual car's 規配代號, and 福斯商旅 dealer practice plus warranty conditions push Multivan owners to annual servicing, so annual is what is costed here. See open questions: this is the single largest swing factor.) NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE PROGRAM: VW Commercial TW gives the Multivan a 5-year warranty (independently confirmed on CarStuff 42452, which states all MY26 models carry a 5-year warranty) — defect cover only. It reduces failure risk in years 1-5 but does not pay for a single oil change, so period_cost in years 1-5 is full retail servicing. The warranty cliff at year 5 is why the years-7 and years-10 windows carry explicit out-of-warranty risk allowances. Alternating pattern: odd-year small service (機油+機油芯+工資, ~8,500) and every-other-year large service (+空氣濾芯, 冷氣濾網, 煞車油, ~18,000), benchmarked against owner-reported VW TW figures of roughly 6,000-8,000 per annual service and uplifted for 福斯商旅 labour rates. CORRECTION vs the prior draft: it repeatedly justified higher costs by calling this a '2.4-tonne' vehicle. The T7 Multivan 2.0 TSI kerb weight is approximately 2,050-2,100 kg; ~2.4 tonnes is closer to its gross vehicle weight. The uplift is retained (it is still a heavy, large three-row van) but the stated basis is corrected. period_cost is per-window (cost since the previous checkpoint), never cumulative.

Benchmarked composite, not a transcribed invoice.
