major_items: 2x annual scheduled services (years 4 and 5), one small + one large
Brake fluid change (4-year, time-based)
First full tyre set — AGE-driven not tread-driven: at 7,000 km/yr the 17-inch tyres still have tread at 35,000 km but are 5 years old and hardening (~32,000 fitted for four on a large van)
Front brake pads (heavy vehicle, due around 35,000 km)
12V AGM start-stop battery (typical 4-5 year life in TW heat, ~10,000)
Spark plugs pulled forward on age rather than the 60,000 km spec
checkpoints.source: Composite: VW TW service scope for the scheduled items; TW retail tyre pricing for 17-inch van-load-rated tyres; standard TW replacement ages for AGM batteries and brake pads on a heavy MPV. Tyre and battery timing is set by AGE because this buyer's mileage never reaches the wear limit — the single biggest low-mileage-specific cost effect in the record. No brand free-maintenance program exists to offset it. Confidence DOWNGRADED to low: the largest line here (the ~32,000 tyre set) is an unsourced retail estimate for this specific size/load rating, and no Multivan-specific TW invoice could be obtained.

major_items: 2x annual scheduled services (years 6 and 7), one small + one large
WARRANTY EXPIRES at year 5 — all repairs from here are owner-paid
DSG (DQ381 7-speed wet-clutch) oil and filter service — 60,000 km spec, done on age at ~7 years (~14,000)
Rear brake pads + front discs (~18,000)
Coolant (G13) change
German out-of-warranty risk allowance ~20,000: water pump / thermostat housing, ignition coil packs, PCV valve — the classic EA888 2.0 TSI items
checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED. No TW receipt set exists for a 7-year T7 Multivan (the generation is only ~4 years old in TW). Built from VW TW published DSG/coolant service scope, TW 福斯商旅 labour rates, and the well-documented EA888 2.0 TSI failure list applied probabilistically. The 5-year warranty term is documented (CarStuff 42452); the failure costs are an allowance, not a quote.

major_items: 3x annual scheduled services (years 8, 9, 10)
Second full tyre set — again age-driven, the year-5 tyres are now 5 years old (~34,000)
Second spark plug set (age/interval-driven, ~5-year cadence) and second 12V AGM battery
Brake discs + pads front and rear (~25,000)

Out-of-warranty risk allowance ~70,000 on a 10-year German van: water pump/thermostat, ignition coils, suspension bushings and dampers under a large heavy van, and the electric sliding-door mechanism — a known and expensive Multivan-family item
Coolant and brake fluid renewals inside the scheduled services
checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED from predecessor-generation ownership patterns, not from T7 data — no 10-year T7 exists anywhere. Scheduled-item costs follow VW TW's published scope; the risk allowance reflects what T5/T6 Multivan owners in TW encounter past year 8 (sliding-door motors, cooling system, suspension). The least certain number in the record: a lucky car lands near 120,000, an unlucky one past 250,000. Note the prior draft justified the year-10 plugs as '60,000 km reached' while also replacing them at year 5 — restated here as a second age-driven set.

assumptions.notes: 低里程車主：每年 6,000-8,000 km，取中位 7,000 km/年，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km/年。各檢查點 assumed_km = 7000 × years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。台灣賓士保養週期為「1 年或 1 萬公里先到者」（lc-car.tw 已查證），在此里程下完全由時間驅動，等於一年進廠一次、里程幾乎不影響保養次數。X254 GLC 200 4MATIC 為 2.0L 渦輪汽油 + 48V ISG 輕油電；因無法純電行駛，依規格歸類為 gasoline 而非 hybrid。X254 於 2023 年 1 月才在台交車，因此僅第 1、3 年有同世代真實成交行情；第 5、7、10 年一律取前代 X253 同齡低里程車的「殘值比」再套回本車 real_cost，並在各 source 字串中標明。重要限制：X253 的 GLC 200 是後驅單驅版（7Car 價格表：GLC 200 234 萬、GLC 300 4MATIC 286 萬，X253 無 GLC 200 4MATIC），本車為 4MATIC，前代對照存在規格落差，殘值「比率」法可吸收大部分但非全部。稅金與保險依設計排除在外。

purchase.source: 正 2026 年式官方售價 NT$2,740,000。本次獨立複查：8891 新車頻道價格表（c.8891.com.tw/news/mercedes-benz/glc/21485）實抓確認「GLC 200(274萬)、300(319萬)、43(402萬)，+1萬元」；U-CAR 原文轉載版（k.sina.com.cn）實抓確認逐字「GLC 200 4Matic 274 +1」。兩個獨立來源一致，與原研究者數字相同，list_price 不需修正。台灣賓士官網 overview／warranty 頁本次仍逾時無法讀取。折讓與領牌費為台灣賓士經銷通路慣例推估，非官方公告。
purchase.notes:
Trim identification: GLC / GLC 200 4MATIC (X254, 2.0L turbo + 48V ISG mild hybrid, 204hp, 台灣單一規格)
list_price 2,740,000 為正 2026 年式 GLC 200 4MATIC 建議售價。已修正原研究者的價格歷程錯誤：兩份來源都明載本次調幅為「+1 萬元」，故前一個年式為 273 萬（不是原文寫的 269 萬）；273 萬也與 8891 中古車上 2025 年式 GLC200 的新車價互相吻合。discounts 取 50,000（約 1.8%）：GLC 是台灣賓士銷量主力、經銷商現金折讓空間小，實務上多以低利分期與配件折抵取代直接降價，故不宜比照 Toyota/VW 給大幅折讓，但也非 Lexus/Porsche 那種完全零折。onroad_fees 取 40,000 = 領牌規費約 5,000 + 代辦費約 5,000 + 交車配件約 30,000（隔熱紙、行李箱墊、迎賓踏板、行車紀錄器、鍍膜）。274 萬的豪華中型 SUV 落在主流品牌（約 15,000）與 Porsche（約 60,000）之間，取 40,000。real_cost = 2,740,000 - 50,000 + 40,000 = 2,730,000。牌照稅與燃料稅依設計不計入。

items.name: 過戶費（監理規費 + 代辦）
售前整備／美容（拋光鍍膜、內裝深度清潔、輪圈整理）
刊登費（8891 中古車／認證平台曝光）

selling_costs.notes: 以自售（private sale）情境估算，與 value_checkpoints 的 private_sale_price 一致。豪華品牌自售前的整備標準比國產車高，車況照片與外觀直接影響成交價，故美容整備抓 10,000（一般國產車約 3,000-5,000）。若改走車商收購（dealer trade-in），售前整備與刊登費可省下，實際 selling cost 會降到約 2,500，但成交價本身就低一截（見各檢查點 dealer_tradein_price），兩者不宜混用。

value_checkpoints.source: 【已複查，維持原值】8891 中古車 GLC200 專頁實抓在架車源：2025 年式 GLC200，3,200 km 開價 238.8 萬、9,000 km 開價 229.8 萬、1.8 萬 km 開價 235.8 萬 —— 皆為【車商開價（dealer retail）】。這批車新車價 273 萬，與本車 274 萬幾乎相同，里程也直接涵蓋本情境的 7,000 km，屬同世代同齡直接可比，並已刻意選用低里程車源。內插取低里程車商開價約 2,340,000 為基準；自售價 = 車商開價 × 0.863 = 2,020,000（近新車的車商加價幅度最大，落在指定的 8-15% 下修帶內偏高端）；車商收購價 = 自售價 × 0.869 = 1,755,000（再下修 13.1%）。殘值 74.0%（對 real_cost），符合德系豪華 SUV 第 1 年重跌的形狀。

【已複查，值維持、confidence 由 high 下修為 medium】8891 中古車 GLC200 專頁實抓 2023 年式（X254 首批，2023/1 起交車）車商開價：4,000 km 205.0 萬、2.8 萬 km 186.8 萬、2.9 萬 km 169.8 萬、4.1 萬 km 193.8 萬。同世代真實資料，但同年份離散度很大（169.8-205.0 萬，達 21%），錨點挑哪一台就決定答案，且原研究者在殘值比之外又疊了一層無資料支撐的「額外微幅下修」，故不足以稱 high。本情境 21,000 km 落在 4,000 與 28,000 km 之間，車商開價可對到約 193 萬。2023 年車新車價 266 萬（非 274 萬），換算殘值比 72.6% 再套回本車 real_cost 得車商開價等值約 1,932,000 → 自售價下修 12% → 1,700,000 → 車商收購價再下修 12.9% → 1,480,000。殘值 62.3%。

【已修正：原 1,430,000／1,245,000，且原 source 內部矛盾】無同世代 5 年資料（X254 在台僅 3.5 年），改用前代 X253。原文同時寫「車商開價約 162 萬」與「殘值比約 58.7%（分母 2021 新車價 242 萬）」，但 162/242 = 66.9%，兩者對不起來；且 162 萬會讓一台 2021 年 X253 只比 8891 實際在架的 2023 年式 X254（2.9 萬 km、169.8 萬）低 8 萬，跨一個完整世代不可能只差這樣。改以殘值比為準重算：8891 實抓 2020 年式 GLC200 車商開價 120.8 萬（8.49 萬 km），依同站 2018 GLC300 的里程敏感度校準（8.03 萬 km 98.8 萬 vs 15 萬 km 82.5 萬，里程降 1.87 倍 → +19.8%）外推到 3.5 萬 km、再加一個年份，得 2021 年式車商開價約 140 萬；對 2021 年 X253 GLC 200 新車價約 242 萬（由 2019 年 234 萬按年度調漲推估）算得殘值比約 57.9%，套回本車 real_cost 得車商開價等值約 1,583,000 → 自售價下修 11.6% → 1,400,000 → 車商收購價再下修 13.2% → 1,215,000。屬「前代同齡 + 里程外推」雙重推估，且前代 GLC 200 為後驅、本車為 4MATIC。

【已修正：原 1,190,000／1,020,000，原文用高階車型墊高低階車型】無同世代 7 年資料，取前代 X253 2019 年式殘值比外推。原文把 GLC300 的 51.0% 與 GLC200 的 46.2% 取中位 47.3%，但本車是 GLC【200】，正確的同階錨點就是 GLC200；且 8891 實抓的那台 2019 GLC300（5.2 萬 km、145.8 萬）在同年份中明顯偏離群（其餘 2019 GLC300：10 萬 km 109.0/118.0 萬、12 萬 km 109.0 萬、13.9 萬 km 103.8 萬），不宜拿來拉高。改採同階錨點：2019 GLC200、5.1 萬 km、車商開價 108 萬，對其 2019 年新車價 234 萬（7Car 價格表已查證）= 46.2%，里程幾乎正中本情境的 49,000 km。套回本車 real_cost 得車商開價等值約 1,261,000 → 自售價下修 12% → 1,110,000 → 車商收購價再下修 14%（車齡越大車商壓價越兇；小曾車庫實例：2019 GLC300 美規 13 萬 km 鑑價 115 萬、實收 90 多萬）→ 955,000。明確為前代殘值比外推，非本車實際成交；前代 GLC 200 為後驅。

【已修正：原 880,000／745,000，這是本記錄最大的錯誤】原文把 7 萬公里的 2016 年 GLC300 外推到車商開價「約 100 萬」，但 8891 同站實抓資料直接否定：2018 年 GLC300 8.03 萬 km 才開 98.8 萬、2017 年 8.6 萬 km 開 95.8 萬 —— 一台 2016 年車不可能在相近里程下開得比 2018 年車還貴。另原文列為 2016 年的三筆錨點中，79.8 萬（16.6 萬 km）與 65.8 萬（17 萬 km）在 8891 上實為【2015】年式，真正的 2016 年錨點只有一筆 67.9 萬（15.13 萬 km）。改用該筆真錨點 + 原文自己的里程敏感度（1.87 倍里程差 → +19.8%，本例 2.16 倍差取 +23%）得 7 萬 km 的 2016 GLC300 車商開價約 84 萬，此值也正確落在 2017 年（8.6 萬 km、95.8 萬）之下，年份階梯合理。對 2016 年 X253 GLC 300 4MATIC 新車價約 279 萬（推估值）計算，殘值比約 30.1%，套回本車 real_cost 得車商開價等值約 822,000 → 自售價下修 11.8% → 725,000 → 車商收購價再下修 15.2%（10 年車商收購需大量整備、周轉慢，壓價最深）→ 615,000。殘值 26.6%，對 10 年德系豪華 SUV 低里程自售屬合理；原文的 32.2% 過於樂觀。雙重外推（前代世代 + 里程），且分母新車價本身為推估值。

maintenance.plan_notes: 台灣賓士【沒有】免費定保方案（注意：本次複查時 mercedes-benz.com.tw 保固頁逾時，無法直接驗證，此判斷來自業界通則而非官方頁面，屬未完全查證項）。新車權益是「3 年不限里程原廠保固」，保固只涵蓋瑕疵維修，定期保養工料仍全額自費，因此第 1-3 年的 period_cost 不能歸零。保養制度為 Assyst Plus 自動提醒的 Service A（小保養）/ Service B（大保養）交替，週期「1 年或 1 萬公里先到者」（lc-car.tw 已實抓查證）。本車主每年僅 7,000 公里，永遠是時間先到 → 完全時間驅動，每年一次、10 年共 10 次，里程對保養次數毫無影響。A/B 交替：第 1 年 A、第 2 年 B、第 3 年 A…第 10 年 B，全期一致。台灣原廠行情已查證：lc-car.tw 明載 Service A 約 8,000-12,000、Service B 約 15,000-25,000（C200 基準）、外廠約原廠五至七成；ts-motor.tw 明載小保養 8,000-10,000、大保養 25,000-30,000、煞車系統 10,000-20,000、懸吊系統 15,000-30,000、引擎系統 20,000-50,000、變速箱 30,000-80,000。GLC 為 2.0T 輕油電中型 SUV，取 A≈11,000、B≈20,000。保固第 3 年到期後，多數車主逐步轉外廠，第 7-10 年已以外廠為主，估算中已反映此折扣。第 7、10 年含德系過保風險項（水泵、恆溫器、點火線圈、M254 汽門室蓋／機油冷卻器油封漏油）以發生機率加權計入，非必定支出。注意：GLC 200 4MATIC 台灣規格標配 AGILITY CONTROL 鋼圈彈簧懸吊，AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊為選配，故未計入氣壓避震的高額風險，若有選配需另加。輪胎在此里程下由老化（5-6 年）而非磨耗決定更換時機。第 5 年（118,000）略高於第 7 年（110,000）並非錯誤：第一套輪胎、第一次變速箱油、第一次冷卻液三項一次性大額項目都落在 3-5 年這個窗口，屬真實現金流形狀，逐年平均仍為 11,000 → 15,500 → 59,000 → 55,000 → 70,000，整體隨車齡上升。10 年合計約 480,000，平均約 48,000/年。

major_items: Service A（原廠）：機油 + 機油濾芯 + XENTRY 電腦檢測
時間驅動：1 年或 1 萬公里先到者，7,000 km 下為 1 年一次
3 年不限里程原廠保固內，無自費故障維修
checkpoints.source: 台灣原廠 Service A 行情 8,000-12,000（lc-car.tw 實抓查證原文「原廠A保費用通常落在新台幣8,000至12,000元之間」，C200 基準；ts-motor.tw 另列小保養 8,000-10,000），GLC 2.0T 車重與工時較高取中上緣 11,000。保養週期依 lc-car.tw 實抓確認「每年或每 1 萬公里」。

major_items: 第 2 年 Service B（原廠）：機油機濾 + 引擎空氣濾芯 + 冷氣濾網 + 煞車油更換（煞車油 2 年一換）
第 3 年 Service A（原廠）
仍在 3 年原廠保固內，僅付保養工料
checkpoints.source: 涵蓋第 1→3 年。Service B 台灣原廠行情 15,000-25,000（lc-car.tw 實抓原文）、Service A 8,000-12,000。本區間 = B(20,000) + A(11,000) = 31,000。煞車油 2 年週期經 lc-car.tw 實抓確認。

major_items: 第 4 年 Service B + 第 5 年 Service A
變速箱油 ATF + 濾網（4-5 年或 6 萬公里先到者，此處為時間到）
冷卻液更換（4 年週期）
第一套輪胎 4 條 235/50R19（5 年橡膠老化，非磨耗；35,000 km 胎紋通常還夠）
前輪煞車來令片第一次
第 3 年保固到期，開始有自費故障風險
checkpoints.source: 涵蓋第 3→5 年。B(20,000) + A(11,000) + ATF 含濾網 22,000 + 冷卻液 5,000 + 輪胎四條 44,000 + 前來令 15,000 = 117,000，取 118,000。變速箱油「4-5 年或 6 萬公里」、冷卻液 4 年、火星塞 6-8 萬公里等週期經 lc-car.tw 實抓逐項確認。輪胎與煞車零件價格為 19 吋豪華 SUV 台灣行情推估，非單一來源；煞車金額落在 ts-motor.tw 煞車系統 10,000-20,000 區間內。

major_items: 第 6 年 Service B + 第 7 年 Service A（開始混用外廠）
火星塞（6-8 萬公里或時間到，此里程下由時間驅動）
12V AGM 輔助電池（輕油電系統對電瓶較敏感，4-6 年更換）
煞車碟盤 + 後輪來令片
懸吊襯套／連桿橡膠件老化
德系過保風險項機率加權：水泵、恆溫器、點火線圈
checkpoints.source: 【已修正：原 112,000，與自身條列加總不符】涵蓋第 5→7 年。B(20,000) + A(11,000) + 火星塞 12,000 + 12V AGM 14,000 + 碟盤含後來令 20,000 + 懸吊襯套 15,000 + 水泵／恆溫器／線圈機率加權 18,000 = 110,000（原文列同樣項目卻寫 112,000）。ts-motor.tw 實抓確認煞車系統 10,000-20,000、懸吊系統 15,000-30,000、引擎系統 20,000-50,000，本估算落在其區間內。風險項為加權期望值而非確定支出，故 confidence 低。

major_items: 第 8 年 Service B + 第 9 年 Service A + 第 10 年 Service B，多數已轉外廠（約原廠 5-7 成）
第二套輪胎 4 條（第 5 年那套已滿 5 年，仍由老化驅動）
變速箱油第二次 + 冷卻液第二次
煞車來令片 + 碟盤第二輪
避震器總成（鋼圈彈簧版；若選配 AIRMATIC 氣壓懸吊，此項會暴增至 80,000-150,000）
M254／M264 常見漏油整修機率加權：汽門室蓋墊片、機油冷卻器油封、水泵
冷氣壓縮機等雜項風險加權
checkpoints.source: 涵蓋第 7→10 年，共三次進廠。外廠 B(16,000)×2 + A(8,000) + 輪胎四條 42,000 + ATF 20,000 + 冷卻液 5,000 + 煞車第二輪 22,000 + 避震器 30,000 + 漏油整修／水泵加權 35,000 + 雜項加權 15,000 = 209,000，取 210,000。外廠折扣依 lc-car.tw 實抓原文「外廠約為原廠五至七成」；變速箱／引擎維修級距參考 ts-motor.tw 實抓數字（變速箱 30,000-80,000、引擎 20,000-50,000），本估算僅取其低段，因低里程車機械負荷輕。整體為推估，非單一帳單。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr, well under the TW average of ~12,000-15,000 km/yr. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). This matters twice: (1) resale — the TW V-Class used pool is heavily commercial/livery use, so most listings at a given age carry 2-3x this mileage; a genuinely private low-km V250d sits at the TOP of its year band, which is where these figures are quoted; (2) maintenance — at 7,000 km/yr the service counter is time-driven, not mileage-driven, so the car still gets a dealer visit roughly once a year and consumables (tyres, brake fluid, coolant, 12V battery) age out rather than wear out. Excluded by design: 牌照稅/燃料費 (this is a 1,950 cc diesel, ~NT$11,920 + NT$4,800/yr), insurance, and fuel. IMPORTANT: at every checkpoint, private_sale_price is derived FROM verified 車商售價 (dealer retail asking) listings by applying an explicit 12-14% haircut — it is never a dealer asking price copied across.

purchase.source: 台灣賓士 MY26/27 新年式 V-Class 價格表, V 250 d Avantgarde 星耀版 NT$2,870,000. INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-11 by direct fetch of two unrelated outlets: 8891新車 (2026-07-21) gives the four-trim table Vito Tourer 摘星版 2,100,000 / V220d AVA 星耀版 2,630,000 / V250d AVA 星耀版 2,870,000 / V250d Exclusive 星耀版 3,600,000; 地球黃金線 TVBS (2026-07-17) gives the identical table and additionally confirms the V250d Avantgarde 星耀版 is the 8-seat variant. The two agree to the dollar, so list_price is treated as hard data (no change from the reviewed record). Discount and on-road figures remain an estimate, calibrated against a Mobile01 owner report of 現金折扣 NT$200,000 + 贈三次保養 on an 18年式 V250d and the current 台灣賓士 '120萬40期零利率或現金折扣' campaign.
purchase.notes:
Trim identification: V-Class (W447) / V 250 d Avantgarde 星耀版 (MY26/27, long wheelbase, 8-seat)
list_price 2,870,000 is the MY26/27 星耀版 price; the 2024 facelift launched at 2,860,000 and the 2026 update added 19-inch alloys, sport suspension, ventilated/heated front seats and a 15-speaker Burmester system at effectively the same money. discounts 150,000 (~5.2%): Mercedes-Benz TW discounts V-Class less than its sedans — it is a low-volume, allocation-limited MPV with steady demand from families and 商務接送 buyers — but dealers do deal. The published incentive is framed as '120萬 40期零利率', worth roughly NT$70,000-90,000 in avoided interest; the cash alternative typically lands NT$120,000-200,000, and the historical 18年式 datapoint was NT$200,000 on a NT$2.82M car. 150,000 is the realistic middle for a cash buyer with no trade-in. onroad_fees 35,000 = 領牌+代辦 ~12,000 plus ~23,000 of near-mandatory fit-out on a vehicle this size (隔熱紙 for 8 windows + panoramic roof, 行車紀錄器, 電動側踏板/腳踏墊, 全車鍍膜). Excludes 牌照稅/燃料費 and insurance per spec. real_cost = 2,870,000 - 150,000 + 35,000 = 2,755,000.

selling_costs.notes: Priced for a private sale (自售), which is what value_checkpoints.private_sale_price assumes. 過戶 itself is cheap in TW — 規費 NT$200 + 強制險過戶 ~NT$1,400 + 牌照 NT$15 + 代辦 NT$800-1,500 — so the real cost is prep. Detailing sits at the top of the normal 4,000-15,000 band because a long-wheelbase 8-seater has roughly twice the interior area of a sedan (three rows, twin sliding doors, large glass area) and buyers of this car inspect the cabin hard. If sold to a dealer instead (dealer_tradein_price), drop the 刊登費 and roughly half the 美容 — call it NT$6,000.

value_checkpoints.source: 8891中古車 V250d pool, re-fetched and re-read 2026-08-11. Verified 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking) listings: 2025 V250d AVA NT$2,498,000 @20,000 km; 2024 V250d AVA NT$2,600,000 @7,474 km; 2024 V250d AVA NT$2,500,000 @6,081 km; FindCar 2024 V250d NT$2,338,000 @10,031 km. Dealer retail for a 1-yr car at only 7,000 km ≈ NT$2,500,000 (anchored on the 2025 ask, with the low-km 2024 examples showing genuinely low-mileage cars hold NT$2.5-2.6M). ADJUSTMENT (dealer retail -> private sale): -12% for the wide margin dealers carry on slow-turning high-ticket MPV stock, and because the private buyer pool for a 1-yr car is thin (most such buyers want dealer warranty/financing) -> 2,200,000. Private -> dealer trade-in a further -12.3% -> 1,930,000. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from the reviewed record's 'high' to 'medium': two separate reads of the same 8891 pool disagree on whether the NT$2,498,000 car is a V250d AVA @20,000 km or a V250d Exclusive @40,000 km, and Exclusive lists at NT$3,600,000, so trim attribution on the single closest comparable is unresolved.

8891中古車, re-fetched 2026-08-11. Three real 車商售價 listings at exactly this age (2023 MY): NT$2,088,000 @7,900 km; NT$1,990,000 @11,000 km; NT$1,928,000 @13,000 km. This buyer's car at 21,000 km carries MORE mileage than all three, so dealer retail is set slightly below the cluster at ≈ NT$1,950,000. ADJUSTMENT: -12% dealer retail -> private sale -> 1,720,000; -13% private -> dealer trade-in -> 1,495,000. NOTE: the reviewed record's sources[] claimed an 8891 year-band of '2020-23 V250d 113.9-162.8萬', which the live pool contradicts outright — the verified 2023 asks are 192.8-208.8萬. That band has been corrected. Car is just out of the 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty here, which is where TW V-Class asking prices step down.

8891中古車 + FindCar, re-fetched 2026-08-11. Verified 車商售價 at this age (2021 MY): NT$1,628,000 @21,136 km (same car listed on both sites), NT$1,600,000 @15,000 km, NT$1,390,000 @43,000 km, NT$1,380,000 @61,000 km, NT$1,139,000 @160,000 km. CORRECTION: the reviewed record set 5-yr dealer retail at NT$1,650,000, which is ABOVE every verified comparable of this age — including the best low-km ask (NT$1,628,000 @21,136 km) even though this buyer's car carries 35,000 km, i.e. more mileage than that car. Dealer retail is therefore reset to ≈ NT$1,540,000, interpolating between the 21,000 km and 43,000 km anchors with a premium for the low-km, privately-owned profile. ADJUSTMENT: -12% to private sale -> 1,355,000; -12.9% to dealer trade-in -> 1,180,000. Spread within the year band is wide because listings mix plain V250d, V250d Avantgarde and V300d/Exclusive; anchored on the Avantgarde-equivalent, low-mileage examples.

EXTRAPOLATED — confirmed 2026-08-11 that no 2019 (7-yr) V250d listing exists in the live TW pool; 8891 jumps straight from 2018 to 2020. TW 2019 V-Class volume was thin because the model was mid-transition to the 2.0 OM654. Bracketed by verified real neighbours: 2020 V250d NT$1,388,000 @59,000 km and NT$1,259,000 @56,300 km (8891); 2018 V250d NT$1,328,000 @72,000 km and NT$1,158,000 @60,000 km (8891); 2018 V250d Avantgarde NT$1,200,000 (abc好車網 #2146186, re-verified) and NT$1,238,000 (abc好車網 #2235507, re-verified). CORRECTION: the reviewed record used NT$1,330,000 dealer retail, at the very top of the 2018 8891 spread and above the entire abc好車網 Avantgarde cluster (1,080,000-1,238,000). Reset to ≈ NT$1,280,000. ADJUSTMENT: -12.1% to private sale -> 1,125,000; -14.2% to dealer trade-in -> 965,000. Trade-in gap widens here because a 7-yr German van is out of warranty and dealers discount harder for reconditioning risk.

DIRECT COMPARABLES (method changed — see below). Verified 車商售價 for 10-yr-old (2016 MY) cars, re-fetched 2026-08-11: 8891 shows V250d Avantgarde NT$948,000 @80,000 km, NT$868,000 @80,000 km, NT$838,000 @60,000 km, V250d NT$858,000 @62,000 km, and V250d Avantgarde NT$1,088,000 @43,000 km; FindCar shows NT$1,130,000 @104,000 km and NT$1,098,000; abc好車網 #2200768 (re-verified) asks NT$1,259,000 for a 2016 V250d Avantgarde with mileage undisclosed. This buyer's car at 70,000 km sits just under the 80,000 km comparables, in Avantgarde spec, so dealer retail ≈ NT$985,000 — near the top of the direct 60,000-80,000 km cluster with a low-mileage premium, but well below the two undisclosed-mileage outliers. ADJUSTMENT: -12.7% to private sale -> 860,000; -14% to dealer trade-in -> 740,000. CORRECTION — THE MAIN ERROR IN THE REVIEWED RECORD: it discarded these direct same-age listings in favour of a retention-ratio transfer (38% of list -> NT$1,100,000 dealer retail) and arrived at private_sale_price 945,000. That figure is effectively the DEALER RETAIL ASK of the closest real comparable (NT$948,000 @80,000 km) reproduced as if it were a private-sale price — the classic 車商售價/自售價 conflation. The ratio transfer was also unnecessary: 2016 cars are the same W447 generation (pre-facelift), so genuine same-age data exists and beats a transferred ratio. Confidence stays low: the pre-facelift Avantgarde listed at NT$3,160,000 against today's NT$2,870,000 星耀版, so spec correspondence is imperfect, 70,000 km at 10 years is far below anything actually in the TW pool, and the 2036 horizon carries real diesel-MPV regulatory risk.

maintenance.plan_notes: No free scheduled-maintenance programme in Taiwan — Mercedes-Benz TW gives 3 years unlimited-mileage warranty (extendable to years 4-6 as a paid product) but service is pay-as-you-go. Free services appear only as a NEGOTIATED sweetener (a Mobile01 owner reported 贈三次保養 bundled with a 現金折扣 NT$200,000 on an 18年式 V250d); that is NOT modelled here, so these figures are the no-freebies case. SERVICE INTERVAL — DISCLOSED CONFLICT: this plan assumes one dealer visit per year, alternating Service A -> B -> A -> B, on the 每 10,000 公里或每滿 1 年（以先到者為準）reading. That reading comes from 比迪行銷, a page that returns HTTP 403 and was only ever read via a search snippet. The one maintenance source actually fetched and verified in full (2ggx, re-read 2026-08-11) states Service A = 1.5 years / 15,000 km and Service B = 2 years / 30,000 km, which at 7,000 km/yr would give roughly 7 visits over 10 years rather than 10. The annual-visit assumption is retained because it is the conservative planning case and matches common TW dealer practice, but period_cost is therefore more likely to be OVERSTATED than understated — treat these as an upper bound. Either way the schedule is TIME-DRIVEN: this car never reaches a mileage-triggered service in 10 years. V250d-specific cost driver: the OM654 2.0 diesel takes ~9 litres of full-synthetic oil plus a diesel fuel filter, so Service A sits at the TOP of the verified NT$8,000-15,000 band and Service B at the top of NT$15,000-30,000+. Wheels are 19-inch on the 星耀版, so a tyre set is NT$40,000+. Consumables are age-driven: tyres replaced on age at ~5-6 years (2 sets in 10 years), brake fluid every 2 years inside Service B, 12V AGM + auxiliary battery at ~6 years, long-life coolant at ~6 years. Years 7 and 10 carry an explicit out-of-warranty risk allowance — the W447's known TW cost items are the electric sliding-door motors/cables, DPF/EGR carbon build-up (aggravated, not helped, by short low-km trips), water pump and thermostat.

Three services (~NT$81,000 at 2ggx bands escalated for age) + second tyre set ~NT$46,000 + 9G-TRONIC oil/filter ~NT$20,000 + DPF/EGR service ~NT$12,000 + full brake overhaul ~NT$26,000 (2ggx rotor/pad bands) + a judged NT$50,000 allowance for out-of-warranty failures (2ggx lists suspension at NT$5,000-25,000+). EXTRAPOLATED: no TW receipt set for a 10-year 70,000 km V-Class was found; the low-mileage profile cuts wear items but does NOT cut age-driven or diesel-short-trip items, and can make DPF/EGR worse. assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000 / 21000 / 35000 / 49000 / 70000). Two consequences drive the model. (1) Resale: at every age this car carries 40-55% of the mileage of a typical comparable listing, so used values are quoted from genuinely low-mileage listings rather than a mileage-blind yearly average. (2) Maintenance: BMW Taiwan's published interval is 'every year OR every 10,000 km, whichever comes first' (re-verified on the yiderbmw dealer service page this round). At 7,000 km/year the mileage trigger is never reached, so servicing is strictly TIME-DRIVEN - exactly one annual visit, 10 visits over 10 years. Consumables that age out on a calendar (tires, brake fluid, coolant, 12V AGM battery) therefore dominate the later periods, while wear items (brake pads/discs) are pushed far out. G45 X3 20 xDrive is a 2.0L B48 TwinPower Turbo with a 48V mild-hybrid system (190 hp / 31.6 kgm); classified 'gasoline' because the 48V system cannot drive the car on its own. Tax and insurance are excluded by design throughout. SECOND-ROUND REVIEW (2026-08-11): a cross-vehicle reviewer flagged the resale curve as internally inconsistent - 1y retention of 82% was the 4th highest in a 17-car set (above every non-Lexus car) while 5y retention of 46% was the weakest of the four German cars, which cannot both be true of one vehicle. The objection was upheld. Root cause: the 1y point was built by applying a retention percentage to the LIST price (2,490,000 x 86%) and then dividing the result by real_cost, which is net of a large discount. Mixing a list-price numerator with a discounted denominator inflates year 1 by roughly 8 points. The 1y point has been rebuilt off the NEW-CAR STREET PRICE instead, and the whole curve re-derived; the discount and the maintenance total were also corrected. See purchase.notes, each value_checkpoint source, and maintenance.plan_notes.

purchase.source: List price NT$2,490,000 re-verified this round by direct fetch of three independent Taiwan sources: Yahoo Autos 2026 BMW X3 20 xDrive xLine trim page (建議售價 249萬, 1998cc, 190hp@4400rpm / 31.6kgm@1500rpm, 8AT, 13.5 km/L combined), KingAutos spec page 11421 (same 249萬, 4755x1920x1660mm, 1855 kg), and the TVBS 地球黃金線 launch report (full G45 TW lineup: xLine 2,490,000 / M Sport 2,770,000 / M50 3,830,000; launched 2024-12-19 by 總代理 汎德, deliveries from Feb 2025). No change to list_price. DISCOUNT RAISED AGAIN, from 270,000 to 300,000. The PTT 菜單 for exactly this trim was re-fetched this round and reads: 牌價 249萬, 實際成交 220萬 first quoted then negotiated to 218萬 - i.e. 290,000 to 310,000 off. Critically, the comment thread does NOT treat that as a generous deal: commenters put it at 'only about 9.7-10% off' and argued it should have landed at 200萬 or below, with one noting that after the ~50,000 vehicle tax the effective saving was small versus deals a year earlier. Modelling 270,000 therefore repeated, at smaller scale, the exact error the previous audit had criticised: it set the modelled discount BELOW both observed transactions while citing those transactions as the evidence. 300,000 (12.0%) puts the street price at 2,190,000, between the two observed deals (2,200,000 and 2,180,000) rather than above both.
purchase.notes: real_cost = 2,490,000 - 300,000 + 35,000 = 2,225,000. BMW Taiwan discounts heavily, unlike Lexus/Porsche/Tesla, so a zero-discount assumption would be badly wrong here - and that heavy discounting is itself a cause of weak residuals, because every used X3 competes against a new one selling ~300,000 below sticker. onroad_fees of 35,000 covers 領牌 + 代辦 (~18,000; a luxury import runs above the mainstream ~15,000 benchmark) plus accessories the dealer did not absorb (~17,000: upgraded 隔熱紙, 腳踏墊, coating). The PTT deal sheet explicitly stated registration fees were NOT included, which is why 領牌 is carried in full while accessory spend is only partial. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded per the model's design. The reviewer asked specifically whether the resale denominator was list price or real paid cost: it is real_cost (2,225,000), and every retention figure quoted in the checkpoint sources below is stated against that number.

items.name: 過戶規費 + 代辦
售前整備與美容 (detailing, paint touch-up, interior)
刊登費 (8891 / SUM listing)

selling_costs.notes: Items sum to 13,000, matching total. Toward the upper end of the 4,000-15,000 band because a 2,000,000+ German SUV needs real presentation spend to achieve a private-sale price - buyers at this level inspect paint and interior closely, and skipping detailing typically costs more in negotiation than the 8,000 saved. The 過戶 government fee alone is only ~1,200-2,000; the rest is 代辦 convenience. Assumes private sale (自售), which is what private_sale_price represents; a dealer trade-in would incur near-zero selling cost but at the much lower dealer_tradein_price. Not objected to by the reviewer and left unchanged across both audits.

value_checkpoints.source: LOWERED from 1,840,000 - this is the correction the reviewer demanded, and the objection is upheld. THE ERROR: the previous value was built as 2,490,000 (LIST) x 86% = 2,140,000 dealer retail, then cut 14% to private sale. Taking a retention ratio off LIST and then reporting the result against real_cost (which is net of a 300,000 discount) double-counts the discount and inflated year 1 to 81.6%, making this car look like a Lexus in year 1 while its year-5 value sat at the bottom of the German group. THE EVIDENCE THAT SETTLES IT, newly found this round by direct fetch of the 8891 xDrive20i listing page: a 2026 X3 20 xDrive xLine - the exact trim - with 2,001 km is listed at 2,230,000 dealer asking. A brand-new one transacts at 2,190,000 before fees (PTT: 220萬 then 218萬). So the near-new 8891 ask EXCEEDS the new-car street price. No one pays more for a used 2,000 km car than for a new one with a full 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty and free choice of colour and spec, which proves the near-new asking segment is padded far beyond the normal 8-15% band and cannot be used as a price anchor at all. The same page shows a 2025 20 xDrive M Sport at 11,000 km asking 2,380,000 (85.9% of its 2,770,000 list, but ~96% of its likely street price) and, decisively, another 2025 M Sport at 45,500 km asking MORE at 2,430,000 - an ask that rises with mileage is noise, not a market. METHOD USED INSTEAD: anchor year 1 to the new-car street price, which is an observed transaction rather than an ask. Taiwan German-premium cars lose roughly 20-28% of street price to a private buyer in the first year; at 7,000 km (about half normal accumulation) this car sits at the kind end. 2,190,000 x ~0.75 = 1,650,000 private sale. Dealer trade-in 12.7% below -> 1,440,000. RESULT: 74.2% of real_cost at one year, inside the 72-76% band the reviewer predicted and in line with GLC and XC60 rather than with Alphard and LM. Confidence medium: the anchor transaction and the exact-trim listing are both real and re-fetched, but the first-year percentage itself is a segment norm applied by judgement, not a measured G45 resale.

RAISED from 1,400,000. This is the best-evidenced point on the curve and it was NOT moved to flatter the shape - it moved only because the previous 64%-of-list assumption was harsher than the listings support. Real G01 LCI xDrive20i 運動版 listings at true 3-year age, all re-fetched from 8891 this round: 2023 Sport, 17,000 km asking 1,750,000; 2023 Sport, 24,500 km asking 1,730,000; 2023 Sport, 60,000 km asking 1,428,000. The two low-mileage cars bracket this buyer's 21,000 km tightly and agree within 20,000, giving ~1,740,000 dealer retail - the tightest cluster anywhere in this dataset. Against that generation's 2,470,000 list that is 70.4%. Applied at 67% to the xLine's 2,490,000, a 3-point haircut for the entry trim (Taiwan buyers pay up for M Sport, and xLine is the bottom of the G45 range whereas 運動版 was a mid trim) = ~1,668,000 DEALER RETAIL. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 12% below dealer retail -> 1,470,000; dealer trade-in a further 12.2% below private -> 1,290,000. That is 66.1% of real_cost, so the 1y-to-3y fall is now 8 points over two years rather than the 20 points the reviewer flagged as the second steepest in the set. CAVEAT ON THE DENOMINATOR: the 2,470,000 original list for the 2022-2023 G01 LCI xDrive20i 運動版 comes from U-CAR, which returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch and could not be re-verified this round or last; if that figure is wrong the ratio moves with it. Confidence medium on the strength of three real same-trim listings, held back from high by the unverifiable denominator.

RAISED slightly from 1,040,000, which is the reviewer's second question - whether 5y ~46% still holds once year 1 is fixed - answered as 'almost, but it was a point or two too harsh'. EXTRAPOLATED: the G45 is only ~20 months old, so no genuine 5-year data exists and none was invented. TWO HONEST READS THAT DISAGREE, both from listings re-fetched this round. (a) Pre-LCI cliff read: real 2021 G01 cars at true 5-year age ask 978,000 at 27,000 km (the same 金鑽-certified Kaohsiung car appears on both 8891 and SUM, so it is ONE data point, not two), 1,058,000 at 72,850 km, 988,000 at 96,000 km, 868,000 at 70,000 km. Against a ~2,330,000 list that is ~42%. This read is structurally apt - a 2026 G45 at 5 years old in 2031 will itself be a pre-facelift car of its generation, exactly as a 2021 G01 is today, since the G45 LCI is expected around 2028. (b) Smooth-decay read: the low-mileage asking sequence for this model family runs 2,230,000 (2026) -> 2,000,000 (2024) -> 1,740,000 (2023) -> 1,468,000 (2022) -> 978,000 (2021), i.e. year-on-year steps of -10%, -13%, -16%, then a -33% cliff. Continuing the smooth part instead of the cliff implies ~52%. WHY THE CLIFF READ IS DISCOUNTED RATHER THAN ADOPTED: the 2021 cars are 白金版 while the 2022 cars are 運動版, so that -33% step mixes a trim change into what looks like a facelift cliff, and I could not verify the 白金版 original list to separate the two. The pre-LCI G01 cohort was also depressed by 外匯車 grey-import supply that is specific to those years. Set at 49% of list = ~1,220,000 DEALER RETAIL, between the two reads. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 12% below -> 1,080,000; dealer trade-in 13% below -> 940,000. That is 48.5% of real_cost, which puts this car at the bottom of the German group (GLC 51, XC60 49, V250d 49, Tiguan 48) but no longer detached from it - defensible because BMW Taiwan's ~12% new-car discount is the largest of the four, and heavy new-car discounting is precisely what suppresses used values. Low confidence: the two predecessor reads still differ by ~10 points and one of them is trim-contaminated.

LOWERED from 850,000. EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor G01 at the same age, expressed as a retention ratio of ITS original list and re-applied to this car. Real 2019 G01 listings re-fetched from SUM this round: 81,376 km asking 928,000 and 130,167 km asking 788,000; the 2018 cohort (8 years) runs 678,000-858,000 at 100,000-156,000 km, with a 243,000 km outlier at 498,000. Every comparable carries 80,000-156,000 km against this buyer's 49,000 km, so a ~+10% low-mileage premium on the 81,376 km / 928,000 car gives ~1,020,000 dealer retail against a ~2,360,000 original list = ~43%, reduced to 38% for the xLine entry trim and because the mileage premium is a judgement rather than a measurement. 2,490,000 x 38% = ~946,000 DEALER RETAIL. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 12% below -> 830,000; dealer trade-in a further 13.9% below -> 715,000 (the dealer spread widens with age because reconditioning is a larger share of a cheaper car). That is 37.3% of real_cost, an 11-point fall from year 5. IMPORTANT HONESTY NOTE, unchanged from the prior version and still true: the observed G01 curve is nearly FLAT between 5 and 7 years (2021 cars 868,000-1,058,000 vs 2019 cars 788,000-928,000) because the 2021s are themselves depressed by the facelift boundary. The modelled 5-to-7 slope is therefore imposed on the reasoning that the G45 will have absorbed its own pre-LCI discount by year 5, not measured from the predecessor. Low confidence.

LOWERED from 550,000. EXTRAPOLATED from the F25 generation (two generations back) at true 10-year age, since neither the G45 nor the G01 is old enough. Real listings re-fetched this round: SUM 2016 F25 at 88,888 km asking 468,000, at 130,200 km 469,000, at 143,866 km 398,000, at 160,000 km 458,000; SUM 2017 F25 at 97,615 km 700,000 and 117,934 km 458,000; 8891 2017 cars at 29,000 km 648,000, 56,000 km 528,000, 100,000 km 458,000, 110,000 km 498,000; 2015 cars at 90,000-97,000 km 380,000-420,000. Interpolating the 10-year (2016) cohort to this buyer's exceptionally low 70,000 km gives ~510,000, against an F25 xDrive20i list of ~2,360,000 = ~22% retention. Set at a kinder 24% (~598,000 DEALER RETAIL) because the G45 is a far better-equipped generation and 70,000 km at 10 years is genuinely exceptional (average would be 120,000-150,000 km); held to 24% rather than higher because the G45's heavy electronics (curved display, BMW OS 9, 48V mild-hybrid system) carry materially more 10-year repair risk than an F25, and a 10-year-old car with a suspect 48V starter-generator is hard to sell at any price. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private sale 12% below -> 530,000; dealer trade-in a further 16% below -> 445,000 (widest spread of the curve, as trade-in bids on decade-old German cars are close to wholesale-auction money). That is 23.8% of real_cost. Low confidence: two-generations-removed extrapolation, and the F25 asking prices scatter widely at similar mileage.

maintenance.plan_notes: TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. RE-VERIFIED BY DIRECT FETCH this round: BMW Taiwan's interval is 每年或每一萬公里 (every year or every 10,000 km, whichever comes first) and the new-car warranty is 2+1年不限里程 (3 years, unlimited mileage), both confirmed on the 台北依德 BMW service page, which also confirms the factory warranty can be extended by 1 or 2 years if a 新車保固到期檢查 is completed before the 36-month mark. At 7,000 km/year the 10,000 km trigger is never reached, so this owner makes exactly ONE scheduled visit per year: 10 visits across 10 years, ~70,000 km total. NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE: the TVBS launch report was re-fetched this round and confirms the G45's only bundled perk is lifetime free navigation map updates - no complimentary servicing - so 汎德's BMW Service Inclusive package is a paid option, not an included one. TOTAL RAISED FROM 390,000 TO 462,000, and the reviewer's objection to the old figure is upheld. The old total made this the CHEAPEST of the four German cars to maintain (GLC 480,000, XC60 437,000, Q5 404,000), and there is no evidence for that ordering: 汎德 parts and labour are not cheaper than 台灣賓士, and BMW carries one structural cost the others do not - RUNFLAT TIRES, fitted as standard, which cost roughly 25-40% more than conventional tires and cannot be plug-repaired, so a single sidewall injury is a whole-tire loss. The G45 also adds a 48V mild-hybrid starter-generator and BMW OS 9 electronics as out-of-warranty risk. The corrected total puts the X3 above the Q5 and XC60 and below the GLC, which is a defensible ordering rather than an unexplained low outlier. Where the increase came from, by window: annual service unit cost raised from ~7,500 to 9,000-10,500 (the Mobile01 '現在7000' quote is an older thread for a plain 2.0, and understates a 2026 B48 with 48V at a 汎德 dealer); tires raised from 50,000 to 60,000 to price genuine 19-inch RUNFLATS rather than conventional tires; front brakes 28,000 -> 34,000; AGM battery 15,000 -> 18,000 to include the battery registration/coding the car requires; and the years 7-10 ageing allowance widened. Because servicing is calendar-based, the cost profile is dominated by items that age out rather than wear out: tires (replaced ~year 6 on age, not tread), brake fluid every 2 years, coolant, and the 12V AGM battery. Conversely brake pads/discs are pushed to ~year 6-7 front and ~year 9 rear. The xLine trim rides on conventional steel springs, NOT air suspension, so air-strut failure cost is correctly excluded from this trim. 10-year total is 462,000, averaging ~46,200/year. HONESTY NOTE: every unit price in the 5-, 7- and 10-year windows is risk-weighted judgement, not receipts, and Mobile01 - the only owner-receipt source available - returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch and could not be re-read this round either.

major_items: Annual scheduled service (time-driven, 10,000 km trigger not reached)
Engine oil + oil filter (原廠機油)
Inspection under 3-year unlimited-km warranty
Wiper blades
checkpoints.source: Covers 0-1 year. RAISED from 8,000. BMW Taiwan's 每年或每一萬公里 interval and the 2+1 year unlimited-mileage warranty were both re-verified by direct fetch of the 台北依德 BMW service page this round. One visit only in this window, fully inside warranty, so no repair exposure. Oil + filter service priced at 9,000 rather than the previous 7,500: the Mobile01 band of 6,000-9,000 comes from threads about older, plainer 2.0 BMWs, and a 2026 B48 with a 48V mild-hybrid system serviced at a 汎德 dealer belongs at the top of that band, not the middle. Wipers 1,000. Sums to 10,000. CAVEAT: Mobile01 returns HTTP 403 to direct fetching and was not re-fetched this round either, so the servicing price band remains a secondary reading.

major_items: 2 x annual oil + filter service (years 2 and 3)
Brake fluid change at year 2 (calendar item, 滿二年要換剎車油)
Cabin/AC filter (冷氣濾網)
Air filter
Wiper blades
checkpoints.source: Covers years 1-3 only, not cumulative. RAISED from 23,000. Two annual services at 9,000 each = 18,000; brake fluid at the 2-year mark 4,000 (a calendar item explicitly called out in the Mobile01 X3 20i thread as 滿二年要換剎車油); cabin + air filters 5,000; wipers 1,000. Sums to 28,000. Still inside the 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty (re-verified on the 台北依德 page this round), so zero repair cost assumed. Cross-check: one Mobile01 owner reported 4 services over 2 years / 60,000 km totalling ~30,000 including spark plugs and brake fluid; this buyer needs only 2 services in the same span but at 2026 prices, so ~28,000 is consistent. Same Mobile01 403 caveat.

major_items: 2 x annual oil + filter service (years 4 and 5)
Brake fluid change at year 4
Coolant change (~year 5, calendar-driven)
12V AGM battery replacement + battery registration/coding (~year 5)
Cabin + air filters
First out-of-warranty minor items (warranty expires at year 3)
checkpoints.source: Covers years 3-5 only. RAISED from 52,000. Two annual services at 9,500 = 19,000; brake fluid 4,000; coolant 6,000; AGM 12V battery 18,000 - raised from 15,000 because a BMW AGM replacement is not just the battery: the car requires battery registration/coding to the power-management module, without which the new battery is chronically undercharged, and that is dealer labour. BMW AGM batteries typically last 4-6 years in Taiwan's heat regardless of mileage, and the Mobile01 X5 養車費用 thread documents an 原廠AGM電池 replacement as a named line item. Filters 5,000; out-of-warranty allowance 10,000 now that the 3-year warranty has lapsed. Sums to 62,000. No tires or brake pads yet - at 35,000 km the original tires still have tread and are only ~5 years old, just short of the age limit. Extrapolated risk pricing, not receipts.

major_items: 2 x annual oil + filter service (years 6 and 7)
Tires: full set of 4 x 19-inch RUNFLATS - AGE-OUT replacement ~year 6, not tread-out
Front brake pads + discs (first set)
Spark plugs (B48, time/mileage due)
Brake fluid change at year 6
Out-of-warranty German risk: electric water pump + thermostat or oil filter housing gasket
checkpoints.source: Covers years 5-7 only - the first genuinely expensive window. RAISED from 135,000. Two annual services 20,000; the dominant item is TIRES at 60,000, raised from 50,000 because the G45 wears RUNFLATS as standard - genuine 19-inch runflats fitted in Taiwan run ~15,000 each against ~11,000-12,000 for a comparable conventional tire, and a runflat cannot be plug-repaired, so this is the single line where BMW is structurally dearer than the Mercedes/Audi/Volvo comparators. Replacement is triggered by the 5-6 year rubber age limit rather than wear: at 49,000 km the originals would still have tread, the classic low-mileage trap. Front pads + discs 34,000 (raised from 28,000 - BMW 原廠 discs on a 1,855 kg SUV are not a budget item); spark plugs 14,000 (Mobile01 t=6459834 lists 火星塞 as a named periodic item); brake fluid 4,000; filters 5,000; plus a 25,000 probability-weighted allowance for the well-known B48 electric water pump/thermostat failure or oil filter housing gasket leak, now fully out of warranty. Sums to 162,000. Air suspension risk is correctly NOT included - the xLine runs steel springs. Extrapolated risk pricing, not receipts.

major_items: 3 x annual oil + filter service (years 8, 9, 10)
Second 12V AGM battery + coding (~year 10)
Rear brake pads + discs
Ignition coils (B48 known failure item)
Electric water pump + thermostat (if not already done in the 5-7 window)
Coolant change (~year 9)
Brake fluid x 2 (years 8 and 10)
Ageing-car allowance: VANOS solenoids, sensors, suspension bushes/dampers, 48V starter-generator risk
checkpoints.source: Covers years 7-10 only, three annual visits. RAISED from 172,000. Services 3 x 10,500 = 31,500; brake fluid x2 8,500; filters 7,000; coolant 6,000; second AGM battery + coding 19,000 (the Mobile01 X5 養車費用 thread documents AGM replacement around the decade / 100,000 km mark); rear pads + discs 28,000 (rears finally due at 70,000 km); ignition coils 16,000; water pump + thermostat 38,000 if not already consumed in the prior window; and a 46,000 general allowance for VANOS solenoids, sensors, bushes/dampers and - the item that most distinguishes this car from a conventional German SUV - 48V mild-hybrid starter-generator exposure on a 10-year-old car, where the part is expensive and the labour is engine-adjacent. Sums to 200,000. No second tire set: the year-6 runflats reach year 10 with only ~28,000 km and ~4 years of age, falling due around year 11-12. Extrapolated risk pricing, not receipts - hence low confidence.

sources.note: PRIMARY price source. RE-FETCHED AND VERIFIED in this second-round review: 建議售價 NT$2,490,000 for the exact trim, model year 2026; 1998cc turbo inline-4, 190 hp @4400rpm / 31.6 kgm @1500rpm, 8AT, 13.5 km/L combined (11.42 city / 15.01 highway).

sources.name: KingAutos - 2025/2026 BMW X3 20 xDrive xLine 規格
sources.note: RE-FETCHED AND VERIFIED in this second-round review. Independent confirmation of NT$2,490,000 for this exact trim, plus 4755x1920x1660mm, 2865mm wheelbase, 1855 kg kerb weight, 570-1700 L cargo, MacPherson front / multi-link rear. assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr (~7,000 km/yr midpoint), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Checkpoint mileage = 7,000 x years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Two consequences drive the record: (1) at 7,000 km/yr any service interval of 10,000 km or more is TIME-triggered, so every service is one per year and wear parts (tyres, pads, fluids, battery) are replaced on AGE rather than wear; (2) resale is quoted against low-mileage listings, which sit above the mileage-blind 行情 average. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費) and insurance are excluded by design. DEPRECIATION CURVE — REBUILT THIS PASS after a cross-vehicle review flagged the curve as the steepest AND the lowest of 17 cars. Root cause found and fixed: the prior draft read only PAGE 1 of the 8891 Audi Q5 listing set and, within each year-cohort, anchored on the CHEAPEST row while describing it as 'the best anchor'. Page 2 (re-fetched this pass, https://auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q5?page=2) contains rows that directly refute three of those anchors: (a) the 2023 @ 6,100 km = 138.0 萬 car the prior draft rebuilt the whole 3-year checkpoint on is the CHEAPEST 2023 listing in the set despite having the LOWEST mileage, and sits 17.8 萬 BELOW a lower-spec 2023 享馭版 with more than double the mileage — an outlier-low signature, not an anchor; (b) the 2020 @ 34,000 km = 84.8 萬 row the prior draft used as a binding cap on the 5-year estimate is contradicted by a 2020 @ 27,000 km asking 98.8 萬, i.e. a lower-mileage car of the same year asking 14 萬 MORE; (c) a third current-generation listing (2025 @ 1,575 km = 239.0 萬) shows year-1 dealer-retail retention is ~86% of list, not the 82% the prior draft applied. The 8891 Audi Q5 population is extremely dispersed — 2021 cars at ~50,000 km span 95.8-116.8 萬 (a 21 萬 spread at identical age and mileage) — so single-row anchoring is invalid throughout and cohort centres are used instead. A separate, explicitly-sized +4% adjustment is applied at years 3/5/7 for SUPERSEDED-GENERATION BIAS: every B9 comparator on the market today is a run-out generation competing against a brand-new redesigned Q5 that launched Oct 2025, whereas this car will be MID-CYCLE at its own 3-5-7 year marks, which is the basis on which every peer vehicle in this comparison is priced. Net effect: 3y retention moves from 48.7% to 55.1% of real_cost and 10y from 17.8% to 22.5%, the largest single-segment drop falls from 23.3 points to 18.6 (group norm is 18.7-19.5), and the car is no longer the group floor at every checkpoint. It remains BELOW BMW X3 and Mercedes GLC at every point, because the observed Audi B9/B8 data genuinely does read softer than the Mercedes and BMW equivalents and because this is the FWD entry trim; the correction regresses toward the German cluster, it does not force a match. Caveat that dominates everything after year 1: this generation only went on sale in Taiwan on 2025-10-02, so it is under 1 year old today (2026-08-11). Only the year-1 checkpoint has current-generation evidence; years 3/5/7/10 are extrapolated from the predecessor (B9 Q5, 2018-2025 TW) and the generation before it (B8, for year 10), and are all marked low confidence. WARRANTY REMAINS UNVERIFIED: audi.com.tw was retried this pass via both WebFetch and curl with a desktop browser user-agent and returns HTTP 503 on every path. Audi Taiwan's long-published standard term is 3 years unlimited mileage, with 5-year cover normally sold as an extended-warranty product or run as a campaign, so the 3-5 year window may well be out of warranty. No warranty claim is treated as load-bearing anywhere in this record.

purchase.source: Re-verified this pass; UNCHANGED. Audi Taiwan's own MY2025 Q5 SUV 規格配備表 PDF (media.audi.com, dated 2025-10-02) prints 建議售價 (萬元) 230 / 270 / 382.9 for 'TFSI 150 kW advanced 進化版 (GUBAZG)' / 'TFSI quattro 150 kW S line 運動版 (GUBAZY)' / SQ5, with 前輪驅動 for the entry trim and 235/55 R19 標準胎. 8891 新車 and 7Car were both re-fetched this pass and both print the identical launch table (Q5 230/270, Sportback 241/281, SQ5 382.9/393.9, SQ5 Edition One 341.5/352.5, launch 2025-10-02). TVBS Auto (2026-07-16) was re-fetched and confirms the MY2026 adjustment verbatim: '包含A5、A5 Avant、A6 Sportback e-tron、A6 Avant e-tron、Q5、Q5 Sportback等多數車型均較舊年式調漲10萬元', plus 'Q5及Q5 Sportback另新增TFSI quattro 150kW進化版車型，開價分別為257萬元、268萬元'. TVBS explicitly does NOT print a line-by-line table naming the entry trim's new figure, and audi.com.tw is unreachable (HTTP 503), so list_price 2,400,000 = 230 萬 (officially sourced) + 10 萬 (officially reported adjustment) remains a DERIVED figure, not a directly quoted one. Corroborated by lineup coherence: 240 / 257 / 280 萬 gives a normal ~17 萬 FWD-to-quattro step, whereas holding the entry at 230 萬 would leave an implausible 27 萬 gap to the new quattro 進化版.
purchase.notes:
Trim identification: Q5 / TFSI 150 kW advanced 進化版 (FWD, 2.0 TFSI 204 ps + 48V MHEV plus, S tronic 7速) — entry trim of the third-generation (PPC platform) Q5, Taiwan launch 2025-10-02
list_price 2,400,000 = MY2026 建議售價 for the entry Q5 TFSI 150 kW advanced 進化版, derived as above (see issues). This is Taiwan Audi's first front-wheel-drive Q5 (台灣奧迪首度引進前驅版本, re-confirmed this pass by KingAutos and 7Car), which matters downstream: TW buyers associate Audi SUVs with quattro, and the mid-grade quattro 進化版 sits only ~17 萬 above, so a ~2% resale penalty is applied uniformly at every checkpoint. DISCOUNT RE-EXAMINED THIS PASS in response to the review, which asked whether a large TW cash discount had been mishandled. Two findings. First, the denominator is NOT the bug: every retention figure in this record divides by real_cost (2,360,000, i.e. money actually paid), never by list price, so a discount cannot mechanically depress the year-1 ratio the way the reviewer hypothesised. Second, discounts 80,000 (~3.3%) is retained because no published Audi TW cash-discount figure could be fetched (audi.com.tw 503) and the car is under one year into a brand-new generation, where deep cash off is not yet offered; Audi Taiwan leads with financing (60期0利率-type campaigns) rather than cash, so this represents a realistic negotiated cash-equivalent (掛牌金/配件折抵). It is deliberately far below the 270,000 used for the BMW X3 in this same comparison, because the X3 figure rests on a fetched PTT deal sheet for a run-out model year and no equivalent evidence exists here. This remains an inference and is listed in issues. onroad_fees 40,000 = 領牌+代辦 (~8,000-10,000: 新領牌照登記規費、驗車、車籍代辦) + 配件 (~30,000: 高階隔熱紙, 行車記錄器, 腳踏墊/門檻條), scaled to a 240 萬 German luxury SUV — between the ~15,000 mainstream level and the ~60,000 Porsche level. Tax and insurance deliberately excluded. real_cost = 2,400,000 - 80,000 + 40,000 = 2,360,000.

selling_costs.notes: Private-sale disposal costs for a luxury SUV; not objected to by the review and left unchanged. 過戶費 is small (監理站規費 plus a 代辦 charge, ~2,000-3,500). 售前整備/美容 scales with class — a 240 萬 Audi needs proper detailing to hold a private-sale price, so 8,000 rather than the ~3,000 a mainstream car gets. 刊登費 assumes a paid 8891 自售 listing with an exposure boost. Total 13,000 sits in the upper half of the 4,000-15,000 band, as expected for this segment. Excludes any 履約保證/驗車服務 the buyer might request.

value_checkpoints.source: RAISED from 1,700,000 / 1,480,000. The only checkpoint with genuine CURRENT-generation evidence, and the evidence base grew this pass. 8891 中古車 (auto.8891.com.tw/audi/q5) re-fetched 2026-08-11 across BOTH result pages now yields THREE new-generation cars, all TFSI quattro 150 kW S line 運動版 against that trim's 270 萬 MY2025 list: 2,360 km = 228.0 萬 (84.4%), 2,000 km = 228.0 萬 (84.4%), and — new this pass, from page 2, missed entirely by the prior draft — 1,575 km = 239.0 萬 (88.5%). Cohort mean ~231.7 萬 = 85.8% dealer-retail retention. The prior draft applied 82%, which is BELOW every single observed data point; that unexplained extra haircut is the error corrected here. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN (all listed figures are 車商售價, i.e. dealer RETAIL asking, never what an owner receives): take 84% of list rather than the observed 85.8%, a deliberate 1.8-point trim because our car carries 7,000 km against the comparables' 1,575-2,360 km — 84% x 240 萬 = 201.6 萬 dealer retail; trimmed 2% for the FWD entry variant = 197.6 萬; private sale = dealer retail MINUS 12% = 174 萬; dealer trade-in (車商收購) = private MINUS 12.9% = 151.5 萬. Low-mileage listings only, not the mileage-blind 行情. Cross-checked against Audi 奧迪嚴選 CPO (re-fetched: 2024 @ 7,113 km = 1,698,000; 2024 @ 13,619 km = 1,528,000; 2024 @ 16,636 km = 1,648,000), used only as an upper bound since CPO asks sit above ordinary 車商售價. Result is 73.7% of real_cost at one year, squarely inside the German-luxury cluster in this comparison (Mercedes GLC 74.0%, Volvo XC60 73.5%, Porsche Cayenne 75.3%).

RAISED from 1,150,000 / 1,000,000 — this was the review's main objection and it is upheld. EXTRAPOLATED from the direct predecessor (B9 Q5); the current generation is under 1 year old in Taiwan, so no real 3-year data exists for it. WHY THE PRIOR FIGURE WAS WRONG: it was rebuilt on a single row, 2023 @ 6,100 km = 138.0 萬 (40 TFSI quattro advanced 進化版), described as 'the single most relevant anchor'. Page 2 of the same 8891 result set, fetched this pass and never seen by the prior draft, shows that row is the CHEAPEST 2023 listing in the whole set despite carrying the LOWEST mileage, and that it sits 17.8 萬 BELOW a 2023 享馭版 with 13,600 km (155.8 萬) — a lower-spec car with more than double the mileage asking substantially more. The 2024 cohort settles the trim ordering in the opposite direction: 進化版 at 169.8 萬 (7,115 km), 167.8 萬 (16,000 km) and 164.8 萬 (16,700 km) versus 享馭版 at 145.0 萬 (9,900 km), i.e. 進化版 normally sits ~22 萬 ABOVE 享馭版. So the 138.0 萬 row is an outlier low, not an anchor. Compounding this, the prior draft 'interpolated' from that row to a 44,600 km car at 122.9 萬 — but the second car is a Technik 豪華版, a cheaper trim, so the interpolation charged a trim step to the mileage slope and manufactured an artificially steep curve. FULL 2023 COHORT re-read 2026-08-11 (車商售價): 進化版 @ 6,100 km = 138.0; 享馭版 @ 13,600 km = 155.8; Technik @ 44,600 and @ 44,800 km = 122.9; 享馭版 @ 49,000 km = 107.0; 享馭版 @ 61,000 km = 109.0; Technik @ 70,000 km = 118.9; Technik @ 76,000 km = 100.5 (萬). TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES now agree: (a) the low-mileage 3-year band is 138.0-155.8 萬 centred ~147 萬 at 6,100-13,600 km, and our 21,000 km sits just above it → ~145 萬 dealer retail; (b) working DOWN from the tight 2024 進化版 cluster at ~167.5 萬, one further year at the segment's ~12%/yr → ~147 萬. Take 145 萬. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 145 萬 x 1.04 for superseded-generation bias (every B9 comparator is a run-out generation competing against the brand-new Q5 launched Oct 2025, whereas this car is mid-cycle at its own 3-year mark — an explicitly sized judgement, not a measurement) = 151 萬; trimmed 2% for FWD = 148 萬 → private sale MINUS 12% = 130 萬 → dealer trade-in MINUS 13.1% = 113 萬. Gives 55.1% of real_cost, versus Volvo XC60 54.8% and Porsche Cayenne 56.0% in this comparison, and still 7 points below BMW X3 and Mercedes GLC (both ~62%) as the softer Audi data and FWD entry trim warrant.

RAISED from 900,000 / 780,000. EXTRAPOLATED from predecessor-generation listings. WHY THE PRIOR FIGURE WAS WRONG: it leaned on a 2020 Q5 @ 34,000 km asking 84.8 萬 as the row that 'most constrains a low-mileage 5-year estimate'. Page 2, fetched this pass, contains a 2020 @ 27,000 km asking 98.8 萬 (45 TFSI quattro Active Plus) — a same-year car with 7,000 km LESS asking 14 萬 MORE. The 84.8 萬 row is therefore the low tail of a wide spread, not a cap, and the prior draft's whole 'mileage barely moves price' inference was drawn from the cheap edge of the distribution. FULL 5-YEAR COHORT re-read 2026-08-11 (2021 cars, 車商售價): @ 48,000 km = 95.8; @ 50,000 km = 106.8; @ 50,000 km = 116.8; @ 61,600 km = 97.9; @ 62,700 km = 97.9; @ 67,000 km = 95.8 (享馭版); @ 110,000 km = 87.5 (萬). Note the dispersion: three cars at essentially 48,000-50,000 km span 95.8-116.8 萬, a 21 萬 spread at identical age and mileage, which is why the cohort CENTRE (~106.5 萬 at ~50,000 km) is used rather than any single row. Our car has 35,000 km, i.e. ~15,000 km less than that centre → ~112 萬 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 112 萬 x 1.04 superseded-generation bias = 116.5 萬; trimmed 2% for FWD = 114 萬 → private sale MINUS 12% = 101 萬 → dealer trade-in MINUS 13.4% = 87.5 萬. Gives 42.8% of real_cost, essentially level with Porsche Cayenne (43.5%) and below BMW X3 (46.1%) and Mercedes GLC (51.3%). This checkpoint may sit at or beyond the end of factory warranty depending on the unverified warranty term; no warranty-driven price support is assumed either way.

RAISED from 670,000 / 580,000. EXTRAPOLATED — no genuine 7-year data exists for this generation. Two 2019 Q5 comparables were found across both pages, both 45 TFSI quattro Active Plus and both at 50,000 km, essentially matching this buyer's 49,000 km: 76.8 萬 and 69.8 萬 車商售價. The prior draft transferred the higher of the two almost directly and, because the mileage already matched, applied no adjustment at all. That single-row transfer is what this pass rejects, on a ladder-consistency test the prior draft never ran: the 2021 cohort centres ~106.5 萬 at ~50,000 km and a 2020 car at 27,000 km asks 98.8 萬, so a smooth age ladder through to a 2019 car at 50,000 km lands near 85-88 萬 — meaning BOTH observed 2019 rows sit below the ladder and are the low tail of the same dispersed population seen at every other age (2021 cars at one mileage span 21 萬). Ladder value ~87 萬 is used, with the two observed rows recorded as the low tail rather than as the estimate. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 87 萬 x 1.04 superseded-generation bias = 90.5 萬; trimmed 2% for FWD = 88.7 萬 → private sale MINUS 12% = 79 萬 → dealer trade-in MINUS 13.9% = 68 萬. Gives 33.5% of real_cost. This is still the lowest 7-year figure in the 17-car comparison, ~2 points under Volkswagen Tiguan (35.4%), Porsche Cayenne (36.7%), Volvo XC60 (36.8%) and BMW X3 (37.7%) — retained deliberately, because the observed Audi B9 data really does read softer than the BMW and Mercedes equivalents at this age and the record should not be curve-fitted past what the evidence supports. Low confidence: cross-generation transfer plus an explicit smoothing judgement, not observed data for the car being priced.

RAISED from 420,000 / 365,000 — the review's second specific objection (10y being the group floor at 17.8%, under Porsche 18.8% and Volvo 19.7%) and it is upheld. EXTRAPOLATED — no 10-year data can exist for a generation launched in Oct 2025, so this transfers older-generation (B8) prices. Real 8891 車商售價 re-read 2026-08-11 across both pages: 2016 @ 92,100 km = 43.8 萬; 2016 @ 150,000 km = 25.9 萬; 2017 (9 yrs) @ 104,300 km = 55.9 萬; 2017 @ 135,000 km = 49.6 萬 (35 TDI); 2015 @ 130,000 km = 23.8 / 28.8 / 37.8 萬. The 2016 pair gives a usable mileage slope of ~3.1 萬 per 10,000 km (17.9 萬 across 57,900 km); extending from 92,100 km down to our 70,000 km adds ~6.9 萬 → ~50.7 萬. WHAT THE PRIOR DRAFT MISSED: it credited only ~4 萬 for the same 22,100 km gap, and it never applied the low-mileage-at-high-age uplift that every peer record in this comparison applies at year 10 — 70,000 km on a 10-year-old car is genuinely exceptional against a 120,000-150,000 km norm, and the BMW X3 record lifts its F25-derived 20-21% retention to 25% for exactly this reason while the Volvo XC60 record lifts 16-17% to 19.5%. Applying the same house treatment here takes ~50.7 萬 to ~61 萬 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 61 萬 trimmed 2% for FWD = 59.8 萬 → private sale MINUS 12% = 53 萬 → dealer trade-in MINUS 15.1% = 45 萬, the widest trade-in cut of any checkpoint because a 10-year-old German SUV needs heavy 整備 and turns over slowly. No superseded-generation uplift is applied here, since the B8 comparators are two generations back and the transfer is already the most speculative in the record. Gives 22.5% of real_cost, now above Porsche Cayenne (18.8%) and Volvo XC60 (19.7%) rather than below every car in the set. Low confidence and doubly so: cross-generation transfer from an older tech era, and at 10 years a German luxury SUV's value is dominated by condition and service history rather than age or mileage. Many TW dealers will simply decline to trade in a 10-year-old Audi at all, in which case 450,000 is optimistic.

maintenance.plan_notes: Not objected to by the review, and no independent evidence was found this pass that any figure is wrong, so the maintenance block is carried over unchanged. SERVICE IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. At 7,000 km/yr any interval of 10,000 km or more is reached on time first, so this owner services once a year and covers only 70,000 km across the whole 10 years. The exact interval (assumed 15,000 km / 12 months) is not printed in the spec sheet and could not be confirmed, but at this mileage the conclusion is insensitive to it. WARRANTY — STILL UNVERIFIED, RETRIED THIS PASS: audi.com.tw returns HTTP 503 to every request, confirmed again via both WebFetch and curl with a desktop browser user-agent, so no warranty term can be sourced. Audi Taiwan's long-published standard is 3 years unlimited mileage, with 5-year cover normally an extended-warranty product or a campaign. This record therefore treats years 1-3 as covered, treats years 3-5 as probably-but-not-certainly covered, and treats everything from year 5 as fully out of warranty. It never relies on the '5 years / 100,000 km' claim an earlier draft took from a search-engine snippet. NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE is bundled into the Taiwan Q5 price — unlike some Lexus/Volvo/Porsche TW programmes, Audi TW sells 原廠保養套餐 as an optional prepaid add-on, so every service below is paid. COST BASIS: 原廠 (authorised dealer) rates for years 1-5, switching to a 專業修護廠 (independent VAG specialist, roughly 40-50% cheaper) for years 6-10, which is what most TW owners actually do. AGE-DRIVEN WEAR: because annual distance is so low, tyres, brake fluid, coolant, the 12V AGM battery and suspension bushings are replaced on AGE, not wear — the tyres in particular go at ~5 years with tread to spare. HONESTY FLAG: no receipt-level source was obtainable (audi.com.tw 503, Mobile01 owner threads 403), so every period_cost is an itemised dealer/workshop-norm build-up for a TW 2.0 TFSI Audi, not a quoted invoice. The EA888-family 2.0 TFSI's known TW failure points (water pump / thermostat housing, ignition coils, cam-adjuster solenoid, valve-cover gasket seepage) are budgeted as risk-weighted allowances in the 5-7 and 7-10 windows, not as certainties.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, well below the TW average of 12,000-15,000 km. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). This matters twice. (1) Servicing: Volvo's interval is 10,000 km OR 12 months, whichever comes first — at 7,000 km/year the CLOCK always wins, so the car gets one time-driven service per year and never a mileage-driven one. Wear items are therefore age-limited, not km-limited: tyres age out (~5-6 years) long before 235/55 R19 rubber wears out (confirmed as the factory size for both Plus and Ultra in Volvo TW's own MY2026 spec sheet), and the 12V AGM battery dies on calendar life. (2) Resale: every live listing found on 8891/SUM at these ages carries 42,000-180,000 km, so market comps were adjusted UPWARD for the low-mileage premium before the dealer-retail -> private-sale haircut. The uplift was capped at about +20% because the observed TW mileage sensitivity is milder than intuition suggests: the same 2021 B5 R-Design sells at NT$1,300,000 @53,000 km and NT$1,059,000 @109,300 km, i.e. roughly 0.35-0.4% per 1,000 km, and trim/condition scatter (NT$728,000-999,000 inside the 2019 cohort alone) dominates mileage at higher ages. POWERTRAIN NOTE: the B5 is a 48V mild hybrid (MHEV, marketed in TW as 輕油電). It is recorded as "gasoline" deliberately — an MHEV cannot move on electric power alone and depreciates on the European-petrol curve, not the Toyota/Lexus full-hybrid curve, so classifying it as "hybrid" would wrongly import a strong-resale anchor. Exact trim matched — MY2026 XC60 B5 Plus AWD is a real TW SKU, no substitution needed. Tax (牌照稅/燃料費/貨物稅) and insurance are excluded by design throughout.

The raw stream yields 'XC60, B5 AWD ... Plus : NT$2,390,000', 'Ultra : NT$2,690,000', and 'XC60, T8 AWD plug in Hybrid ... Ultra : NT$2,990,000', alongside the sheet's own version stamp '2026 03' and a 2025 Volvo Car Corporation copyright line. Same PDF confirms 235/55 R19 tyres on Plus and Ultra, Geartronic 8 transmission, and option code 117 (HUD) priced at NT$60,000 on the lower trim. CarStuff independently reports the identical three prices. list_price therefore confirmed at NT$2,390,000 — 0% deviation from the reviewed record, no correction needed. Discount anchored on Volvo TW's own published 隨心入主方案 launch price of NT$2,240,000 for B5 Plus (CarStuff, launch April 2026) = NT$150,000 off list.
purchase.notes:
Trim identification: XC60 / B5 Plus AWD (MY2026, 2度小改款; B5 = 1,969cc turbo + 48V mild hybrid, 250hp +14hp, Geartronic 8AT, 235/55 R19)
list_price 2,390,000 is the official 建議售價, verified by direct extraction from Volvo TW's MY2026 price sheet (not from a search snippet). discounts 150,000 (6.3%) = the manufacturer's own published 隨心入主 cash-equivalent level. CAVEAT I ADDED ON REVIEW: I fetched the August 2026 8891 Volvo promo page and it shows NO cash discount for XC60 — the current package is a free HUD upgrade plus NT$1,200,000/40-period 0% finance, and the page notes buyers may '放棄高額零利率換取純空車現金折扣'. Valuing that swap at a ~3.5% market rate over 40 periods yields only about NT$70,000-90,000 of interest, so 150,000 rests on the April launch price as a negotiating anchor rather than on a live August offer. It is retained because Volvo TW genuinely discounts (PTT 菜單 for the prior model year settled at NT$2,090,000, ~13% off) and 6.3% is modest for this brand, but a buyer walking in today could land anywhere from 100,000 to 180,000. Two sweeteners deliberately NOT stacked into `discounts`: (a) the free HUD worth NT$60,000 — the PDF confirms it is a NT$60,000 factory option, so it inflates the car rather than cutting the outlay; (b) the NT$100,000 舊換新 + 貨物稅減徵 incentive — a TAX rebate, excluded by design, and it requires scrapping a qualifying old car. onroad_fees 40,000 = 領牌/規費 ~5,000 + 代辦費 ~5,000 + a realistic premium-SUV accessory pack ~30,000 (隔熱紙 for a large panoramic-roof SUV ~20,000, 行車記錄器 ~7,000, 原廠腳踏墊/防水托盤 ~5,000). Scaled to the NT$2.39M price point — above the ~15,000 mainstream level, well under the ~60,000 Porsche level. real_cost = 2,390,000 - 150,000 + 40,000 = 2,280,000.

selling_costs.notes: Priced for a PRIVATE sale (自售), consistent with private_sale_price being the headline resale figure. 過戶 itself is cheap in Taiwan (規費 a few hundred, 代辦 ~1,500). The real money is pre-sale detailing: a NT$1M+ premium SUV will not photograph or show well without proper paint correction and interior work, and skipping it costs more in negotiation than the 8,000 saves. Listing fees on 8891/SUM for a self-listed car run ~2,000-3,000. Total 12,500 sits at the upper end of the normal 4,000-15,000 band, which is right for this class. A dealer trade-in (dealer_tradein_price) would avoid the listing fee and most of the prep, but that discount is already baked into the trade-in number itself. Reviewed and left unchanged — this was the one section with no defects.

value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED UPWARD on review. The reviewed record described its anchor comp as '25年式 XC60 B5 (2025-registered), 11,704 km, NT$1,758,000' on SUM. I re-fetched the SUM XC60 listing page: the 11,704 km / NT$1,758,000 car exists and the mileage matches exactly, but SUM lists it as a **2024**, not a 2025 — i.e. a TWO-year-old car, not one. The original therefore applied only a +4% nudge where a full extra year of age was owed, biasing year 1 downward. Corrected chain: NT$1,758,000 車商售價 for a 2-year-old at 11,704 km, x1.08 for being one model year younger and x1.02 for 7,000 vs 11,704 km, and then held back to ~NT$1,880,000 rather than the arithmetic 1,937,000 because dealer ASKING prices overstate the market and 8891's own 2-year-old T8 Recharge Ultimate (top trim, list NT$2,990,000) asks only NT$1,950,000. Then -11% -> 自售價 1,675,000, then -13% -> 車商收購價 1,455,000. Implies ~73% of real_cost after year 1, which is a normal first-year hit for European premium in TW. Also corrected a transcription error carried in the original: the 8891 2024 T8 Ultimate comp is at 1,900 km, not 19,000 km. Confidence held at medium — this rests on a single dealer listing of unstated trim.

VERIFIED, figure unchanged; attribution corrected. The reviewed record credited these comps to '8891 (三立汽車 Taipei / Tainan)'. Still inside Volvo TW's 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty at this point, which supports the price.

CORRECTED UPWARD on review — the original double-discounted. It stripped an '8-10% SELEKT certification premium' off a NT$1,370,000 @31,000 km listing that appears in NEITHER my 8891 nor my SUM fetch (unverifiable), and THEN applied a further x0.94 R-Design->Plus trim scale, cutting the same car twice. SUM 2021 cars: @80,691 km NT$1,188,000 (this one the original did cite correctly), @83,477 km NT$999,000, @92,567 km NT$1,288,000, @102,410 km NT$1,098,000, @109,457 km NT$989,000. The 8891 R-Design pair brackets the mileage sensitivity directly — NT$1,300,000 vs NT$1,059,000 across 56,300 km is ~0.4% per 1,000 km. Applying that to the ~NT$1,098,000 median at ~93,000 km gives +20% (capped) for our 35,000 km -> ~NT$1,318,000, less ~5% because the comp set skews R-Design/Inscription against our Plus -> ~NT$1,252,000 車商售價. Then -11% -> 自售價 1,115,000, -13% -> 車商收購價 970,000. ~49% of real_cost at 5 years. Supporting context: the 2021 XC60 B5 Momentum listed new at NT$2,390,000 (7Car), identical to today's B5 Plus, so this is a genuine like-for-like retention read rather than an inflation-adjusted guess.

FIGURE RETAINED, SOURCING CORRECTED, CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED to low. The original's key anchor was 'a 2019 T5 R-Design NT$998,000 @46,000 km, near-exact mileage match'. That car is real but 8891 lists it as a **2020**, not a 2019 — the original built a 7-year checkpoint on a 6-year-old car, embedding one year too little depreciation. Rebuilt from genuine 2019 comps. SUM 2019 cars: @80,742 km NT$999,000, @84,395 km NT$799,000, @90,000 km NT$728,000, @108,047 km NT$980,000; 8891 2019 T5 Momentum @130,000 km NT$698,000. Two independent routes: (a) the 2019 cohort means ~NT$877,000 at ~91,000 km, +14.7% for our 49,000 km and -5% for trim mix -> ~NT$955,000 車商售價; (b) working DOWN from the mislabelled 2020 R-Design, NT$998,000 x0.92 for one more year x0.94 for R-Design->Plus -> ~NT$863,000. The two routes bracket ~NT$860,000-955,000, and the original's implied ~NT$940,000 sits inside that band — so despite the misattributed comp the number survives and I have not moved it. Chain from ~NT$945,000 車商售價: -11% -> 自售價 840,000, -13% -> 車商收購價 730,000. Confidence cut from medium to low for two reasons the original understated: the anchor comp was misdated, and the 2019 cohort scatters from NT$728,000 to NT$999,000 at nearly identical mileage, so trim and condition dominate — plus these are T5/T6 pure petrol, since the B5 48V mild hybrid only reached TW in MY2021. Now out of the 3-year factory warranty, which is the main reason the curve steepens here.

EXTRAPOLATED — no genuine 10-year data exists for this generation, and this was already flagged honestly in the reviewed record. The current SPA XC60 launched in TW in 2017-2018, so a 2016 car is the PREDECESSOR first-generation XC60. Method per instruction: real gen-1 prices at ~10+ years old, verified in my own SUM fetch (2015 @152,213 km NT$328,000; 2015 @167,874 km NT$368,000; 2014 @180,203 km NT$288,000; 2014 @184,397 km NT$388,000; 2013 @199,000 km NT$268,000), expressed as a ratio of gen-1's own original list (~NT$2,090,000 for T5 R-Design) = ~16-17% dealer-retail retention at 150,000+ km. The original adjusted +25% for our 70,000 km; I regard that as too generous given the ~0.35-0.4%/1,000 km sensitivity measured on the gen-2 comps, which implies nearer +15% -> ~19.5% dealer retail -> ~17.4% private -> ~NT$397,000 against real_cost. Offsetting that, gen-2 demonstrably holds a flatter curve than gen-1 (49% at 5 years, 37% at 7 here). The two adjustments push in opposite directions and roughly cancel, so 450,000 is retained as the midpoint of a ~NT$400,000-500,000 honest range. dealer_tradein 385,000 is a further -14%; the trade-in spread narrows in absolute terms at this age because the dealer's fixed reconditioning cost dominates. Confidence LOW and explicitly so — this is an honest extrapolation, not a sourced figure.

maintenance.plan_notes: CONFIRMED ON REVIEW — Volvo Taiwan has NO free scheduled maintenance program. I re-checked all three legs of this claim independently and every one holds. (1) WARRANTY: the standard new-car warranty is 3 years, UNLIMITED mileage for private use (3 years / 100,000 km for commercial), covering engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, electrics, cooling, paint and glass, with roadside assistance included and consumables excluded. It is not 5 years. A 4th-5th year 延長保固 exists but must be PURCHASED, only within 36 months of registration and under 100,000 km. (2) MAINTENANCE: Volvo TW's program is the 「VOLVO 保養服務合約」 — a PREPAID, PAID contract bought at time of purchase that bundles the scheduled services from 10,000 to 50,000 km, plus an upgraded 「VOLVO PLUS」 tier that also covers wear items (wipers, brake pads, brake fluid, starter battery). It is a prepayment convenience, not a giveaway, so period_cost below is NOT reduced the way a genuine Lexus/Porsche-style free-maintenance program would justify. Unused contract balance does transfer to the next owner on resale, a small resale support. (3) CURRENT PROMO: the August 2026 Volvo TW incentive page offers XC60 buyers a free HUD and 0% finance only — no free servicing, and the 4th-year extended warranty in that campaign applies to V60/XC90 but explicitly NOT to XC60. SERVICE INTERVAL: 10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. At 7,000 km/year the buyer NEVER reaches the km trigger, so servicing is purely TIME-DRIVEN — exactly one visit per year, ~10 visits over 10 years, and only 70,000 km by year 10. COST BASIS: an itemised real owner receipt on the PTT car board, which I fetched and verified line by line — 10,000 km service NT$9,062 total (labour NT$1,575, engine oil NT$4,998, oil filter NT$756, drain plug NT$126, plus NT$1,607 of optional additives) and 20,000 km service NT$11,543 (labour NT$2,678, engine oil NT$4,998, oil filter NT$767, brake fluid NT$756, drain plug NT$126, cabin filter NT$800 self-installed, plus optionals). Note the receipt car is a T6, not a B5, and the post dates from October 2020, so figures below are inflated ~15-20% to 2026 parts/labour rates. Years 1-3 are inside warranty so carry service cost only; years 4 onward add out-of-warranty repair risk, which for a European premium SUV is the real cost driver, not the oil changes.

assumptions.notes: Low-mileage owner: 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). Two consequences run through the record. (1) Resale: a mileage premium is applied ONLY where the comparable listing actually has more kilometres than our car. This is the main correction made to the reviewed draft — the previous version applied a low-mileage premium at every checkpoint, including year 1 and year 3, where the 8891 comps used (2025 Coupé at 6,391 km; 2023 non-Coupé at 20,000 km) already sat at essentially our car's mileage, so the premium was counted twice: once by picking the top of the comp band, again as an explicit percentage uplift. Premium is now applied at years 5 and 7 only (comps there run 63,000-70,000 km against our 35,000-49,000). (2) Maintenance: Porsche's service interval is 15,000 km OR 12 months, whichever comes first, and the manual defines three tiers (小保養 15,000km / 中保養 30,000km / 大保養 60,000km). At 7,000 km/year NONE of those mileage thresholds is reached inside 10 years, so the plan is entirely TIME-driven — but time-driven does NOT mean 'a cheap oil service every year', which is where the reviewed draft went wrong. The sub-items carry their own time clocks (brake fluid 2 years, 火星塞 and centre-diff oil 4 years) and Porsche Taiwan bundles them into a full 大保養 at the 4-year and 8-year marks regardless of odometer: a 2020 Cayenne Coupé at four years and just 26,500 km paid NT$70,000 for exactly that service. So this plan is eight annual oil services plus two 大保養. Consumables likewise age out rather than wear out: tyres are replaced on a ~5-6 year age limit, not on tread depth, and the AGM battery on a 4-6 year clock. Tax (牌照稅 ~11,230/yr for 2,995cc + 燃料費 ~6,180/yr) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design and appear nowhere in this record.

purchase.notes:
Trim identification: Cayenne / Cayenne (base) 3.0L V6 twin-scroll turbo, 353PS / 500Nm, 8AT AWD — 2026年式, standard spec with NO options (19-inch wheels, steel springs, no Sport Chrono)
THIS IS AN OPTION-FREE CAR AND THAT IS NOT REALISTIC IN TAIWAN. The 419萬 base Cayenne as shipped has cloth-and-leatherette seats, 19-inch wheels, STEEL SPRINGS and no Sport Chrono. Virtually no Cayenne is delivered in Taiwan this way — the typical ordered car carries NT$300,000-800,000 of options (氣壓懸吊 ~150,000, PDCC, Sport Chrono ~70,000, 20/21-inch wheels ~100,000-200,000, BOSE ~90,000, 全景天窗 ~80,000), so real out-the-door money is commonly 450萬-500萬. Options were excluded from list_price per the brief. Two asymmetries to keep in mind: (a) options inflate entry cost roughly 1:1, and (b) they recover only about 30-40% of their cost at resale, so an option-heavy car depreciates HARDER in absolute NT$ than this record shows. Conversely a no-option car is genuinely harder to sell used in Taiwan — buyers here expect air suspension and big wheels on a Cayenne. That drag IS modelled: it is one reason the year-1 private-sale figure was cut and its confidence downgraded to low. The steel-spring reality is also carried consistently into the maintenance plan: the year-10 risk allowance excludes 氣壓懸吊 struts and pump (1car prices those at 30,000-50,000 PER CORNER, i.e. 120,000-200,000 for four) and budgets conventional dampers at ~70,000 instead. discounts=0 is a real finding, not a placeholder.
