value_checkpoints.source: REVISED DOWN from the draft's 3,350,000. 8891 中古車 (auto.8891.com.tw/porsche/cayenne, re-fetched by the previous review 2026-08-11) contains only ONE genuine 1-year comp: 2025年式 Cayenne Coupé 3.0T, 6,391 km, 車商售價 447.0萬 (a 2024年式 Coupé 31,900 km at 527.0萬 is a higher trim, and the 2024 Coupé 13,000 km at 429.8萬 is a 2-year car). No non-Coupé, no-option 1-year listing exists anywhere reachable. Derivation: 447.0萬 asking − Coupé body premium (~25萬, from the 2023 ladder where Coupé 391萬 vs Cayenne 369萬) − option content recovery (a typical Coupé carries 50-80萬 of options recovering only ~30-40%, so ~20萬 of the asking price) ⇒ ~400萬 車商售價 for an equivalently-aged no-option non-Coupé. That is an ASPIRATIONAL asking price on the slowest-selling Cayenne spec, so it is discounted to ~355萬 realistic 車商售價 (85% of list). RETAIL→PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 355萬 × 0.90 = ~320萬 私人自售. NO low-mileage premium is applied here — the comp is at 6,391 km against our 7,000 km, so none is owed; the draft added +3% on top of an already-low-mileage comp, which is double-counting. dealer_tradein = 320萬 −11.9% ≈ 282萬. The 447.0萬 figure is a dealer ASKING price and was never used directly. Confidence LOW: one comp, wrong body style, and three stacked judgement adjustments. NOT re-opened by this maintenance-focused review — the reviewer raised no objection to resale.

REVISED DOWN from the draft's 2,600,000 — the largest single resale correction and the best-anchored checkpoint in the record. 8891 中古車 (re-fetched 2026-08-11) has a near-perfect spec-and-mileage match: 2023年式 Cayenne 3.0T NON-Coupé, 20,000 km, 車商售價 248.0萬. Same body, same engine, 3 years old, and 20,000 km against our 21,000 km. Against that car's own 369萬 list that is 67.2% 車商售價 retention. The draft took 70% ('top of the band, because 21,000 km is roughly 60% of the typical 3-year odometer') — but the comp itself was ALREADY a 20,000 km car, so the top of the band was already the low-mileage case and the premium was counted twice. CORRECTED DERIVATION: start from the comp's actual 248.0萬 asking; uplift ~7% because our car is a 2026年式 sold against a 419萬 ladder rather than a 369萬 one (used markets absorb roughly half of a list-price increase at this age, not all of it) ⇒ ~265萬 車商售價. RETAIL→PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 265萬 × 0.90 = 238.5萬 私人自售, rounded to 238萬. NO further low-mileage premium (comp already matches our odometer). dealer_tradein = 238萬 −13.0% ≈ 207萬. Cross-check: 金帝國際 1car.com.tw guide gives 0-3年 240-300萬 / 殘值 60-70%, but that is dealer marketing content and is mileage-blind; our 56.8%-of-list private figure sits correctly BELOW a dealer-retail band. The 248.0萬 asking price was NOT copied into private_sale_price. NOT re-opened by this maintenance-focused review.

REVISED DOWN from the draft's 1,980,000. 8891 中古車 (re-fetched 2026-08-11), non-Coupé 3.0T: 2021年式, 70,000 km, 車商售價 168.8萬 (two separate listings at this exact price/mileage); 2020年式, 110,000 km, 136.0萬 and 148.8萬. Against the 339.8萬 list of that era the 5-year point is ~49.7% 車商售價 retention. HERE THE LOW-MILEAGE PREMIUM IS GENUINELY OWED — our car shows 35,000 km against the comps' 70,000 km, i.e. half. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 168.8萬 asking + ~13% for halving the odometer ⇒ ~191萬; + ~8% for the newer 419萬 price ladder (half pass-through) ⇒ ~207萬 車商售價. RETAIL→PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 207萬 × 0.895 ≈ 185萬 私人自售. dealer_tradein = 185萬 −13.0% ≈ 161萬. The draft reached 198萬 by applying a 53% retention to the full 419萬 list, which passes the entire list-price hike through to a 5-year-old car; that is too generous — a used buyer prices a 5-year Cayenne on absolute money and on the cars parked next to it, not on what a new one now costs. Secondary cross-check: 1car.com.tw guide gives 5年 150-200萬 / 殘值 40-50% (mileage-blind average of 60,000-80,000 km cars); our 185萬 private sits near the top of that band, which is where a 35,000 km car belongs. Year 5 is where the trade-in gap widens: the factory warranty is gone and dealers price in reconditioning plus their own warranty exposure. NOT re-opened by this maintenance-focused review.

REVISED DOWN from the draft's 1,680,000, and confidence downgraded from medium to LOW. Genuine same-generation data exists — the E3 Cayenne launched in Taiwan Apr-2018, so 2019年式 cars are exactly 7 years old today — but the listings are extremely noisy. 8891 中古車 (re-fetched 2026-08-11), non-Coupé: 2019, 64,000 km, 162.8萬; 2019, 112,000 km, 122.8萬; 2019, 123,000 km, 182.8萬 (almost certainly a higher trim); 2018, 60,000 km, 139.8萬; 2018, 80,000 km, 178.0萬; 2018, 92,000 km, 129.8萬. Against the 339.8萬 list of that era these span roughly 36-52% retention with NO monotonic relationship to mileage, which means option content, trim and 原廠 service history dominate the spread and none of it is disclosed in the listings. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: take the best mileage-comparable genuine comp (2019, 64,000 km, 162.8萬), add ~6% for our lower 49,000 km ⇒ ~172萬; add ~8% for the newer price ladder (half pass-through) ⇒ ~187萬 車商售價; but haircut to ~175萬 because our car is a stripped no-option example and the spread above shows spec is worth more than mileage at this age. RETAIL→PRIVATE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 175萬 × 0.89 ≈ 156萬 私人自售. dealer_tradein = 156萬 −14.1% ≈ 134萬. The trade-in haircut widens again at 7 years — Taiwanese dealers are wary of out-of-warranty Cayennes and price in water-pump and suspension risk even on a low-mileage example, which the corrected maintenance plan now quantifies at NT$90,000 of expected out-of-warranty spend in this very window. Confidence is LOW because the comp band is ±16 percentage points wide and the record's own spec (no options) sits at the weak end of it. NOT re-opened by this maintenance-focused review.

EXTRAPOLATED — no genuine 10-year data exists for this generation, and REVISED DOWN from the draft's 900,000. The E3 Cayenne only reached Taiwan in April 2018, so the oldest example is 8 years old; a 10-year figure cannot be observed. Method per the brief: take the PREDECESSOR generation (E2 / 958.2, sold in Taiwan to 2017) at 9-10 years, express it as a retention ratio of ITS original list, then apply that ratio to this car's real_cost. Predecessor evidence from 8891 中古車 (re-fetched 2026-08-11): 2017, 50,000 km, 車商售價 71.8萬; 2016, 137,600 km, 58.9萬; 2015, 120,000 km, 58.8萬; 2015, 80,000 km, 69.8萬. NOTE — the draft leaned on two higher E2 quotes (2017/61,000 km/88.0萬 and 2017/95,000 km/95.8萬, both from an 8891 page-2 fetch that could not be reproduced) while a LOWER-mileage 2017 asking only 71.8萬 sat on page 1 and went unused; that selective read is why the draft's 23% retention was too high. Against an E2 base list of roughly 330萬 (STILL UNVERIFIED — this remains the weakest link in the record) the verified comps imply 17.8% (2016, high km) to 21.8% (2017, 50,000 km) 車商售價 retention. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 20% for a 10-year / 70,000 km car × real_cost 4,250,000 ≈ 85萬 車商售價; RETAIL→PRIVATE −10% ⇒ ~76.5萬, rounded up to 80萬 私人自售 for the low odometer. dealer_tradein = 80萬 −18.8% ≈ 65萬. The trade-in discount is deliberately steeper than the 12-14% used at earlier ages: at 10 years most Taiwanese dealers either refuse a Cayenne outright or lowball it hard, because a single suspension or turbo failure exceeds the whole car's margin — the corrected maintenance plan puts NT$180,000 of expected out-of-warranty risk in the 7-10 year window, which is the same fact seen from the dealer's side. Cross-check: 1car.com.tw guide gives 10年以上 = 80-120萬 / 殘值 20-30%, but that is a DEALER RETAIL band, so a private figure at 80萬 is consistent with sitting at its bottom edge. NOT re-opened by this maintenance-focused review.

maintenance.plan_notes:
NO FREE SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE. Porsche Taiwan gives a new-vehicle warranty (unlimited mileage; the Mobile01 thread '保時捷 Cayenne Coupé 保固前四年一次大保養工單分享' implies a 4-year term, and Porsche Approved Warranty extensions run in 12/24/36-month blocks afterwards), but that warranty covers manufacturing defects only. The owner pays for EVERY scheduled service from day one — that is why the year-1 period_cost is not zero. There is no prepaid 保養包 published on Porsche Taiwan's own site; a historically offered 4年/8萬km package (7 小保養 + 2 大保養) was quoted around NT$140,000, but it is priced for a 20,000 km/year driver and does not fit this record's 7,000 km/year profile, so it is not used.

THIS SECTION WAS REBUILT AFTER REVIEW — 10-YEAR TOTAL RAISED FROM NT$651,000 TO NT$1,044,000 (+60%). The reviewer was right and the draft was wrong. Three concrete errors were found, and one of them is decisive:
(1) THE 4-YEAR SERVICE IS A 大保養, NOT AN OIL CHANGE. The draft assumed that because the 15,000 km mileage trigger is never reached, every visit is a NT$16,000-18,000 小保養. That is false. Porsche's schedule is 小保養 15,000km / 中間保養 30,000km / 主保養 60,000km on mileage, but the individual sub-items (火星塞, 中央差速器油, 煞車油, 各項濾芯) carry their own TIME clocks, and Porsche Taiwan bundles them into a full 大保養 at the 4-year mark regardless of odometer. A near-perfect comp was found for this record's exact profile: a 2020 Cayenne Coupé at FOUR YEARS and only 26,500 km (≈6,600 km/year, essentially our 7,000) paid NT$70,000 at 原廠 — '我的2020年Cayenne Coupe 四年26500公里大保養費用，都按保時捷原廠的保養項目施工，費用是70000元' (Mobile01 f=608 t=6928421). The draft budgeted roughly NT$36,000 for the whole year-4/year-5 window. That single receipt is now the anchor for the year-4 and year-8 services.
(2) CONSUMABLES WERE PRICED AT INDEPENDENT-SHOP RATES WHILE THE PLAN OTHERWISE ASSUMED 原廠. The draft took 煞車皮+碟盤 15,000-25,000 per axle and 性能胎 30,000-50,000 per set straight from 1car.com.tw. Those are 專修廠/副廠 numbers — carce.cc's real Cayenne transactions show aftermarket pads alone at 6,200 + 800 labour (front) and 4,500 + 1,200 (rear), with no discs, and a Shopee 副廠 disc set runs 10,000 front / 9,000 rear. Porsche 原廠 parts at a 3,150/hr labour rate land an axle of discs + pads + wear sensor at NT$48,000-55,000, not 25,000. Tyres were checked independently: this car's 19-inch OEM size is 255/55R19, and BigGo Taiwan lists Michelin Pilot Sport 4 SUV at NT$9,823 and Latitude Sport 3 at NT$9,992 EACH in the discount online channel, Continental CSC5 SUV at 11,300 — an N-spec set of four fitted and balanced is ~NT$52,000, not the draft's 36,000.
(3) THE OUT-OF-WARRANTY ALLOWANCES WERE CUT ON A CORRECT ARGUMENT TO A WRONG NUMBER. The draft was right that this record's declared spec has STEEL SPRINGS, so 1car's 氣壓懸吊每側 30,000-50,000 (i.e. 120,000-200,000 for four corners) cannot be charged. But it then dropped the year-10 allowance from 150,000 to 90,000, which does not follow: conventional dampers still cost roughly NT$70,000 for four corners at 原廠, and the cooling/timing/turbo/electronics risks are unchanged. Allowances are now 90,000 (5-7y) and 180,000 (7-10y). Supporting evidence: TYAward puts the probability of needing a major repair at ~60.89% and average annual maintenance at ~US$3,827 in years 5-10; 1car lists 渦輪積碳 and high-mileage 懸吊異音 as Cayenne 通病; independent Taiwan workshops flag E3 water-pump leaks as a common LOW-mileage failure.

SERVICE TRIGGER AT THIS MILEAGE: 15,000 km or 12 months, whichever first. At 7,000 km/year the MILEAGE trigger is never reached, so the plan is entirely TIME-DRIVEN — one service every year, with the 4-year and 8-year visits escalating to a full 原廠 大保養. Brake fluid runs on a 2-year clock (y2, y4, y6, y8, y10 — five changes). 火星塞 and 中央差速器油 run on a 4-year clock and fall inside the y4 and y8 大保養. Gearbox oil is specced at 240,000 km / 16 years, so on paper it never comes due; it is nonetheless budgeted once at year 8 because real Porsche Taiwan owners do it and the sourced price is high ('換變速箱油十幾萬', PTT car板) — see the honest-subtraction note below. CONSUMABLES AGE OUT RATHER THAN WEAR OUT: tyres are replaced on a ~5-6 year age limit with tread remaining (y5 and y10), the AGM 12V battery dies on a 4-6 year clock (y6 and y10, NT$15,000-30,000 each at 原廠 including coding), and low-mileage cars in Taiwan's humidity lose brake discs to surface corrosion rather than to wear.

COST BASIS (real Taiwan receipts, not list prices): 原廠 小保養 (oil + filter, incl. labour) NT$12,361-16,000 per PTT car板 owner receipts Oct-2024, corroborated at NT$15,000-16,000 by TYAward and '原廠小保養 1.6 萬起跳' by UpToGo; 原廠 4-year 大保養 NT$70,000 at 26,500 km (Mobile01); Porsche Taiwan workshop labour NT$3,150/hour (PTT; TYAward: '單一小時的工資往往突破3,000元'); 變速箱油 '十幾萬' and '保時捷只有大保養可能破十萬' (PTT car板).

HOW TO BACK OUT THE JUDGEMENT CALLS. Of the NT$1,044,000 total, NT$270,000 is probabilistic risk allowance (90,000 + 180,000) and NT$100,000 is the elective year-8 gearbox-oil service. A strict reading — no unplanned failures at all, and gearbox oil left alone per the 240,000 km spec — gives NT$674,000 of purely scheduled work. A reader who thinks the allowances are too fat should subtract from 1,044,000 rather than treat it as a floor. Conversely, an owner who moves to a 專修廠 after the warranty expires can cut the brake, tyre and 大保養 lines by roughly 40%, which is the single largest legitimate way to come in below this plan.

CROSS-VEHICLE SANITY CHECK (the reviewer's actual test): NT$1,044,000 is 2.18x the Mercedes GLC 200's NT$480,000 and 2.39x the Volvo XC60's NT$437,000 in this same comparison set — inside the reviewer's requested 1.8-2.5x band and inside the 900,000-1,300,000 absolute band. Note that percentage-of-purchase-price is NOT a good invariant here and should not be used to police this figure: a NT$4,250,000 car does not need 3.2x the servicing of a NT$1,313,000 Tiguan just because it costs 3.2x as much, so the Cayenne's 24.6% will always sit near the Tiguan's 24.1% without that meaning anything. The absolute figure and the ratio to the German premium SUVs are the checks that carry information. TYAward's US-derived 10-year figure (US$20,552 ≈ NT$616,500) is deliberately NOT used as a ceiling: it is US parts pricing at US average mileage, and Taiwan adds import duty on parts to an already higher base. Tax (牌照稅 ~11,230/yr for 2,995cc + 燃料費 ~6,180/yr) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design and appear nowhere in this record.

checkpoints.source: 草稿 280,000 → 527,000，是全表金額最大的一段，兩個主因。(1) 第8年是第二次 4 年期原廠大保養 (依據同第5年檢查點的 Mobile01 t=6928421 工單 70,000，通膨後取 80,000)，草稿完全沒有編列這一筆，只放了三次小保養。(2) 變速箱油由 45,000 改為 100,000: PTT car板 同一帖車主明講「這剛開始而已，換變速箱油十幾萬你就知道」，同帖另有「保時捷只有大保養可能破十萬」—— 十幾萬取最保守下緣 100,000。這筆是本表最大的可裁撤項目: 原廠規格其實是 24萬km/16年，嚴格照規格可以整筆拿掉，10 年總額就從 1,044,000 降到 944,000，這點在 plan_notes 有明講。風險準備金由 90,000 提高到 180,000: 草稿「本車是鋼製彈簧、不能編氣壓懸吊」的推論本身正確 (1car 列氣壓懸吊每側 30,000-50,000，四角就是 12-20 萬)，但由此得出準備金應該更低並不成立 —— 傳統避震筒四支在原廠仍約 70,000，冷卻、正時、渦輪、電子的風險完全沒變，草稿等於把「不必花的那一項」誤讀成「整體風險變小」。第二套輪胎與第二顆電瓶依 5-6 年與 4-6 年的老化週期編列。涵蓋 7-10 年。屬推估非實帳，confidence low。

assumptions.notes: 每年 6,000-8,000 公里，取中位 7,000 公里/年，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 公里。所有檢查點一律 7,000 × 年數（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 公里）。兩個關鍵影響：(1) 原廠保養週期是「第 N 年或 N×20,000 公里，以先到者為準」，此里程下 10 年內永遠是年數先到，等於每 2 年一次主要回廠；(2) 中古市場同齡低里程車明顯高於均價，本表殘值一律錨定 8891 上同齡『最低里程段』實際刊登，再做車商開價→自售價的向下調整。台灣電動車現行免徵牌照稅與燃料費，但依設定，稅與保險一律不計入本表。

purchase.notes:
Trim identification: Model Y / Long Range AWD 雙馬達全輪驅動（2025 煥新版 Juniper 小改款，19 吋 Crossflow 鋁圈，WLTP 641 km，16 吋 QHD 中控螢幕）
定的是 Long Range AWD 雙馬達（2,299,900），不是入門 RWD（1,899,900）。折扣 0：Tesla 台灣原廠直營單一定價、無經銷商、無業代可殺價。已驗證存在但屬條件式、基準情境不計入的優惠：2026 年 4 月 Tesla 台灣首次推出「油轉電補助」30,000 元（KingAutos 標題已證實，需以燃油車換購）。領牌與代辦 30,000 元組成：監理規費與領牌約 8,000 元（Tesla 自行處理領牌交車，無業代代辦費）+ 交車配件約 22,000 元（腳踏墊、隔熱紙、前擋與局部包膜、行李廂墊）。刻意排除：牌照稅與燃料費（電動車現行免徵）、強制險與任意險、家用充電樁安裝（另約 30,000-80,000 元，屬基礎建設非領牌費）。車重 1,979 kg，在輪胎耗損上會回頭咬人。買點風險（本次新增，直接影響殘值）：229.99 萬是台灣 Model Y 四年來的價格高點，且是第二次站上這個數字 —— 2022-09 上市即 229.99 萬，五個月後（2023-02）原廠自行降 18 萬（−7.8%），此後兩年一直落在 210.79-212.79 萬，直到 2025-03 煥新版才漲回 229.99 萬。本車買在振幅約 9% 的價格帶頂端，而分母（實付價）不會跟著原廠降價一起下修，這是本表 5 年以後殘值低於原研究者的主因。

items.name: 過戶監理規費與代辦
售前整備與美容（洗車鍍膜、內裝清潔、輪胎與輪圈整理、補漆筆）
8891／SUM 個人自售刊登費

selling_costs.notes: 以「個人自售」情境估算，對應 value_checkpoints 的 private_sale_price。台灣汽車過戶監理規費本身只有數百元，實務上請代辦或車行代跑約 1,500-3,000 元；Tesla 另需在 App 上做車輛所有權轉移，該動作免費。電動車自售有一項成本已含在整備裡：買方普遍要求出示電池健康度報告，2025.8.3 版之後車主可自行在車上跑（控制 > 服務 > 電池健康，約 18 小時），不需回原廠、不另收費。若改走車行收購（dealer_tradein_price）則整備與刊登費由車行吸收，但售價再低一截，已反映在 dealer_tradein_price。

value_checkpoints.source: 1 年錨點重估（reviewer 爭點之一，已下修）。台灣煥新版 2025-03-01 才開賣、實際交車自 2025 年中起，故 8891 全站目前只有 2 筆 2025 年領牌煥新版，且都是 RWD：1,850,000 / 9,000 公里與 1,850,000 / 14,000 公里（車齡約 1.1 年），對煥新版 RWD 新車實付 1,929,900 = 95.9% 車商開價。兩段調整：(1) 車型差 —— 本次以 2024 年領牌同齡樣本實測 LR 與 RWD 的落差：RWD 在 33,000-45,000 公里區間共 10 筆、中位數 1,553,000，對其原始實付 1,764,900 = 88.0%；同批唯一 LR 為 1,688,000 / 38,800 公里，對原始實付 2,137,900 = 79.0%，LR 低 9.0 個百分點。原研究者第 1 年只扣 5.5 點，實測不支持縮小，故 LR 第 1 年車商開價約 86.9%，含本案 7,000 公里的低里程加成取 88% × 2,329,900 ≈ 2,050,000。(2) 車商開價 → 個人自售 −14.2%：本次以 8891 listing 有無『實體車行』標記分群實測，2022 年份 LR 無車行標記者中位數 1,253,000 / 里程中位數 70,500 公里、有車行標記者 1,488,000 / 75,200 公里，在里程更低的情況下仍便宜 15.8%；一年車的價差最大（車商開價 1,850,000 幾乎貼著新車 1,899,900、達 97.4%，實務上不可能以此成交），故取區間上緣。得自售 1,760,000（實付價的 75.5%），再 −13.1% 到車商收購 1,530,000。原研究者給 1,870,000（80.3%），其 RWD→LR 只扣 5.5 點、開價→自售只扣 11.6%，兩處都比實測寬鬆。confidence 訂 low：直接同齡證據只有 2 筆、且是別的動力車型。

8891 實抓（2026-08-11，本次覆核自行解析 6 頁共 120 筆去重物件）。本次取得官方售價異動全紀錄後，分母改用各年份的真實牌價而非估值：2023 年領牌 LR 的原始牌價為 211.99-212.79 萬（2023-02-03 降價後），實付約 2,157,900。該年份 8891 共 13 筆、車商開價 1,450,000-1,588,000、里程 66,000-135,000 公里（另 1 筆 1,998,000 / 100,000 公里為離群已剔除），最低里程者 1,558,000 / 66,000 公里 = 72.2% 車商開價（車齡約 3.0 年）。本案 3 年僅 21,000 公里，遠低於這批。以本次擬合的 LR 車商開價曲線（1.1 年 86.9%、2.1 年 79.0%、3.6 年 65.2%，近乎線性 −8.7 個百分點/年）取第 3 年 70.4%，加低里程加成 1.5 點得 71.9% × 2,329,900 ≈ 1,675,000 車商開價；車商開價 → 自售 −12.5% = 1,465,000，再 −12.6% 到車商收購 = 1,280,000。與原研究者的 1,480,000 只差 1%，代表這一格原本就大致正確，改動只是為了與重建後的曲線一致。confidence medium：樣本厚（2022+2023 兩個年份共 38 筆 LR）且分母已是官方牌價，但沒有任何一筆同齡物件的里程接近 21,000 公里，低里程段仍靠外推。

5 年錨點重估（reviewer 爭點之二，本次改動最大的一格）。先更正一個事實錯誤：原研究者寫『最老實例是 2022 年領牌 = 4.3 年』，但台灣 Model Y 是 2022-09-23 才上市、U-CAR 事件簿明載『最快 12 月交車』，2022 年領牌車實際車齡約 3.6 年 —— 原本以為只需外推 0.7 年，實際要外推 1.4 年，這使原值系統性偏高。重建方式四步：(1) 唯一分母相同的對照組：2022 年領牌 LR 的原始牌價正是 229.99 萬（U-CAR 事件簿上市價），實付 2,329,900，與本車完全相同，不必做任何跨年式價格換算。該批 8891 實抓 25 筆，取里程 ≤70,000 公里者共 10 筆、中位數 1,518,000 = 65.2% 車商開價（3.6 年）。(2) 併同 1.1 年 86.9%、2.1 年 79.0%，LR 車商開價保值率在 1-3.6 年間近乎線性 −8.7 個百分點/年，外推第 5 年約 53.1%，加本案 35,000 公里的低里程加成取 55.0%。(3) 獨立交叉驗證：代理車 Model 3 Long Range 2021 年領牌（車齡 5.1 年，原始牌價 195.79 萬、實付約 1,982,900）8891 實抓 18 筆，取里程 ≤65,000 公里者中位數 1,039,000 = 52.4% 車商開價 —— 與上述外推的 53% 幾乎重合，兩條互不相關的路徑收斂。(4) 再扣 3% 的世代風險：本車已是煥新版，而現有 2022/2023 兩個年份的 LR 開價被壓在同一個 1,450,000-1,588,000 區間（差一整年車齡卻幾乎沒有價差），是改款把舊造型的曲線壓平的訊號；現有樣本反而是 2025 年改款漲價 19.2 萬的受惠方，本車到 2031 年將站在受害的一側。得車商開價約 1,244,000，自售 −12.4% = 1,090,000（實付價的 46.8%），再 −12.8% 到車商收購 = 950,000。第 4 年基本保固（4 年/80,000 公里）到期是這一段斜率特別陡的機制性原因，非統計雜訊。原研究者給 1,270,000（54.5%）。confidence low：台灣沒有滿 5 年的 Model Y，主證來自 3.6 年實測外推 + Model 3 同齡代理車。

台灣沒有 7 年的 Model Y（2022-12 才開始交車），改用『前一世代同廠車』外推，明說是外推。代理車 Model 3 Long Range，原始牌價這次取得官方數字：2019-08-12 在台發表，SR+ 155.99 萬 / LR 186.99 萬 / Performance 214.99 萬（U-CAR 事件簿），故 2019 年領牌 LR 實付約 1,894,900。8891 實抓 2019 年領牌 Model 3 共 8 筆，其中 LR 4 筆：820,000 / 40,000 公里、858,000 / 116,000 公里、788,000 / 163,000 公里、788,000 / 164,000 公里（車齡約 7.1 年）。取里程 ≤120,000 公里者中位數 839,000 = 44.3% 車商開價 —— 原研究者只取單筆 820,000 並用 1,999,000 這個估值當分母得 41.0%，分母是猜的、分子是單點，本次改用官方牌價與中位數。Model Y 對 Model 3 的車格加成：以 2022 年份同齡對照，Model Y LR 低里程開價保值率 65.2%、Model 3 LR（2022 年領牌、原始牌價約 205 萬）低里程 1,288,000 / 28,000 公里 = 62.1%，差約 3 個百分點，比原研究者假設的 4 點略小。故第 7 年取 44.3 + 1.7（本案 49,000 公里遠低於代理車樣本的里程中位數）= 46.0%，再扣 5% 世代風險（理由同 5 年格）得 43.7% × 2,329,900 ≈ 1,018,000 車商開價，自售 −11.6% = 900,000，再 −12.8% 到車商收購 = 785,000。第 4 年基本保固已過、第 8 年電池與驅動單元保固將到期，是這段持續下滑的主因。原研究者給 950,000。

台灣沒有任何 10 年的 Tesla 量產車樣本，全部外推，明說。代理車 8891 實抓（2026-08-11 本次獨立解析 Model S 13 筆、Model X 30 筆）：2018 年領牌 Model S 75D 998,000 / 66,000 公里（車齡 8.1 年）、2017 年領牌 75D 958,000 / 236,000 公里（9.1 年）。關鍵修正在分母：原研究者假設 Model S 75D 原始台灣售價約 3,900,000，本次查 U-CAR Model S 事件簿發現 2017-04-17 原廠已把 Model S 75 由 344.4 萬大砍 57.7 萬至 286.7 萬，75D（四驅版）約 306 萬、實付約 3,050,000，比原研究者的分母低了 85 萬。改用正確分母後，8.1 年低里程的實際車商開價保值率是 998,000 / 3,050,000 = 32.7%，而非原研究者算出的 25.6-28%。兩個方向相反的修正：Model S 是 300 萬級距旗艦、百分比保值率本就系統性低於中價位車（往上修）；但本車第 8 年電池與驅動單元保固（8 年/192,000 公里）到期後高壓電池全額自費，且 2026/07 台灣已發生 Model Y 高壓電池故障、原廠無現貨需等一個月且無代步車的實例（KingAutos 已證實），加上買在價格帶頂端（見 purchase.notes）與世代風險（同 5 年格）（往下修）。淨取 28.5% × 2,329,900 ≈ 664,000 車商開價，自售 −10.4% = 595,000（實付價的 25.5%），再 −12.6% 到車商收購 = 520,000。本案 10 年僅 70,000 公里，遠低於代理車樣本，低里程加成已含在上述比率內。原研究者給 620,000。

maintenance.plan_notes: Tesla 台灣沒有免費定期保養方案，也沒有強制回廠保養 —— 不回廠不影響原廠保固。原廠週期是「第 N 年或 N×20,000 公里，以先到者為準」；本車每年只跑 7,000 公里、10 年只有 70,000 公里，所以整段持有期都由『時間』觸發、永遠碰不到里程門檻，實際節奏是每 2 年一次主要回廠（第 2、4、6、8、10 年），單數年只有雨刷與輪胎對調。BEV 沒有機油、機油芯、火星塞、變速箱油、廢氣檢驗；馬達油原廠建議 300,000-400,000 公里才換，本車 10 年用不到。仍要花錢的三件事：(1) 輪胎 —— 車重 1,979 kg + 電動馬達扭力，但本車里程低，實際是『胎齡到期』而非磨光；(2) 煞車油每 4 年更換；(3) 冷氣濾網每 2 年、HEPA 濾網每 3 年、冷氣乾燥包每 4 年。動能回收讓來令片幾乎不磨耗，10 年只抓一次碟盤/來令片更換，主因是台灣潮濕造成碟盤鏽蝕而非磨損。本次覆核（2026-08-11）重新抓取 CJay Tech 台灣特斯拉原廠價目表並逐項比對，頁面自載更新日仍為 2026/6/26，Model Y 2025+ 欄實際值全數相符：底盤巡視與扭力檢查 3,912、冷氣濾網 1,397、冷氣乾燥包 3,876、煞車油 3,053、HEPA 濾網 3,730、雨刷一對 2,006、16V 鋰電池 9,055、馬達油 6,268、技師工資 2,415/小時，均已含工資、料件與 5% 營業稅，冷媒 R1234YF 9.45/g。輪胎配置為 10 年一整套（第 6 年胎齡到期換）+ 第 10 年補兩條 —— 原研究者原本排兩整套（第 5 年、第 10 年），但第 5 年僅 35,000 公里、胎紋遠未到底，且第二套若在第 10 年更換其胎齡僅 4 年，屬重複計列。10 年保養合計 188,500 元；扣掉輪胎 48,000 元後為 140,500 元，與《消費者報告》「Tesla 10 年保養約合新台幣 13 萬（不含輪胎）」的量級吻合。reviewer 認可本區塊合理，本次覆核未更動任何保養金額。
